texto: With an ongoing lawsuit regarding the collection of scanning fees and a civil inquiry pending before the Espírito Santo Public Prosecutor’s Office, Centrorochas has been closely monitoring the movements regarding extra fees charged to exporters in the State. During a meeting of the Fiscal Deliberative Council, held this Friday, February 18, the group widely debated the issue and defined the next steps to be taken in order to preserve the good course of commercial practice. During the meeting, the directors defined the monthly fee table according to the category of members. To meet: – Effective Member: All companies that participate in the economic activity of exporting ornamental stones, once the statutory and normative requirements are met, may be admitted to the membership, in the category of effective member; – Institutional Associate: In order to better achieve its objective of representing and assisting the entire class of Brazilian ornamental stone exporters, reaching the greatest possible number of associated and represented members, Federations, Unions, Associations and other representative bodies of the class, which have among its associates, companies that export ornamental stones may join the entity in the institutional associate category; – Special Members: Companies whose activity is mining, industry or the trade of ornamental stones that intend to export their products, but which effectively do not yet carry out export operations, may be admitted to the category of Special Member for a period of two years, term in which they will have to make the export of their products feasible, even counting on the help of Centrorochas; – Collaborating associates: Companies, organizations or associations that work in related activities and with confluent interests may also be admitted as collaborating associates. The meeting was led by the president of the entity, Tales Machado, the vice president, Fabio Cruz, and the executive director, Celmo de Freitas.

texto: Com ação judicial em curso referente à cobrança de taxa de escaneamento e inquérito civil em trâmite no Ministério Público do Espírito Santo, o Centrorochas vem acompanhando de perto as movimentações referentes a taxas extras cobradas dos exportadores no Estado. Durante reunião do Conselho Deliberativo Fiscal, realizada nesta sexta-feira, 18 de fevereiro, o grupo debateu amplamente o tema e definiu os próximos passos a serem dados de forma a preservar o bom curso da prática comercial. Durante o encontro, os conselheiros definiram a tabela de valores das mensalidades conforme categoria dos associados. A conhecer: – Associado efetivo: Todas as empresas que participem da atividade econômica de exportação de rochas ornamentais, satisfeitas as exigências estatutárias e normativas, poderão ser admitidas no quadro social, na categoria de associado efetivo; – Associado institucional: Para melhor alcançar seu objetivo de representar e auxiliar toda a classe dos exportadores de rochas ornamentais brasileiros, alcançando o maior número possível de associados e representados, as Federações, os Sindicatos, as Associações e outros órgãos representativos da classe, que tiverem entre seus associados empresas que exportam rochas ornamentais, poderão se filiar à entidade na categoria associado institucional; – Associados especiais: As empresas cuja atividade é a mineração, indústria ou o comércio de rochas ornamentais que pretendam exportar seus produtos, mas que efetivamente ainda não realizam operações de exportação, poderão ser admitidas na categoria de associado especial pelo prazo de dois anos, prazo em que deverão viabilizar a exportação de seus produtos, podendo contar, inclusive, com a ajuda do Centrorochas; – Associados colaboradores: Também poderão ser admitidas, como associados colaboradores, empresas, organizações ou associações que atuem em atividades correlatas e com interesses confluentes. A reunião foi comandada pelo presidente da entidade, Tales Machado, o vice-presidente, Fabio Cruz, e o diretor-executivo, Celmo de Freitas.

titulo: EU Commission starts 1st stage of so-called taxonomy that will require precise descriptions of sustainability
resumo: Content released on the Stone Ideas portal this week details the movement adopted by the EU Commission that is taking its climate policy seriously: the 1st stage of the so-called taxonomy came into force on January 1, 2022. This means that, in the future, sustainability of each project must be described based on precise criteria – comparability must be created based on facts, and every buyer must be guided by this, from citizens to large corporations. The taxonomy is a central step in the implementation of the “European Green Deal”. Click here and check out the original text, in full!

titulo: Stone sector breaks historical export record in the 1st year of the Centrorochas and ApexBrasil partnership

Brazilian exports of ornamental stones in 2021 surpassed the revenue levels recorded in the pre-pandemic period and in the entire history of the segment. texto: Exports record in 2021 the best revenue in the history of the sector, 1.34 billion dollars, according to data released by the Brazilian Center of Ornamental Stones Exporters. Brazilian exports of ornamental stones in 2021 surpassed the revenue levels recorded in the pre-pandemic period and in the entire history of the segment. According to data released by the Brazilian Center for Ornamental Stones Exporters (Centrorochas), last year the country earned US$1.34 billion. Between January and December, the national sector sent 2.4 million tons to 132 countries spread across five continents and recorded growth of 35.5% compared to 2020. export its products after signing the sectoral agreement signed between Centrorochas and the Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency (ApexBrasil). Together, the two entities develop It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone, a project to encourage exports in the sector that currently supports around 140 companies. The United States appears in the lead as the largest consumer, representing 62.7% of all exports. China (11.5%), Italy (6.5%) and Mexico (3.8%) occupy the next positions. The four countries are part of the eight target markets identified by the sectorial project. “In a year with serious logistical complexities, the national stone sector broke this historical record. Centrorochas’ credibility with entrepreneurs, added to the milder scenario of the pandemic in the second half of 2021, the development of actions in the sectoral project and also the heating up of the global civil construction sector, contributed to this advance. We surpassed by almost 40 million dollars our highest revenue so far, which had been registered in 2013”, detailed the president of Centrorochas, Tales Machado. “The year 2021 was full of challenges, but together we were able to turn them into opportunities and victories. It is gratifying to see that our partnership with the ornamental stone sector produced record exports and, consequently, generated more jobs and income for the benefit of thousands of Brazilian families”, said the president of ApexBrasil, Augusto Pestana. Major exporting states Espírito Santo (83.3%), Minas Gerais (9.9%) and Ceará (2.8%) were the three states that most exported ornamental stones from January to December last year. The state of Espírito Santo was the largest exporter in the segment in 2021, accumulating a total of US$ 1.14 billion, accounting for 83.3% of the total value of stone exports made by Brazil. The evolution of Espírito Santo during the year, in relation to the previous year, was 37.02% in value (dollar) and 8.95% in weight (ton), showing an organic growth in added value of exported materials of 25.77% average price (dollar/ton). Minas Gerais totaled US$ 132.76 million and growth of 25.5%, remaining as the second largest Brazilian power among the largest exporters. Ceará, on the other hand, accumulated a total of US$ 37.87 million and 50% growth in exports in the analyzed period, highlighting the shipment of quartzites, raw or processed. According to the president of the Union of Dimension Stones, Lime and Limestones of the State of Espírito Santo (Sindirochas), Ed Martins, the sector is responsible for approximately 10% of Espírito Santo’s GDP and concentrates the largest number of companies in the country, generating about 25 thousand direct and 100 indirect jobs in the state. “The rock production chain has close to 1,600 companies in Espírito Santo and 200 mining fronts. When we look at the foreign market, without neglecting our domestic market, one of the advantages of our industry is its diversity, which allows us to meet the needs of markets with different profiles”, he pointed out. About It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone is an export incentive program developed by the Brazilian Center for Ornamental Stones Exporters (Centrorochas) in partnership with the Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency (ApexBrasil). The program aims to stimulate and increase exports of Brazilian ornamental stones, through a set of strategic internationalization actions with promotion actions, strengthening the image and development of the sector in the world market. About Centrorochas The Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Pedras Ornamentais acts directly in the procedures related to the presence of Brazilian businessmen abroad combined with commercial and operational activities related to the development and evolution of Brazilian companies. About ApexBrasil ApexBrasil acts to promote Brazilian products and services abroad and attract foreign investment to strategic sectors of the Brazilian economy. To achieve these objectives, the Agency carries out different actions trade promotion activities aimed at promoting exports and valuing Brazilian products and services abroad, such as prospective and trade missions, business roundtables, support for the participation of Brazilian companies in major international fairs, visits by foreign buyers and opinion makers to meet the Brazilian productive structure among other business platforms that also aim to strengthen the Brazil brand. (Photo credit Gramazini – publicity)

texto: Exportações registram em 2021 o melhor faturamento da história do setor, 1,34 bilhões de dólares, segundo dados divulgados pelo Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais. As exportações brasileiras de rochas ornamentais superaram em 2021 os níveis de faturamento registrados no período pré-pandemia e em toda a história do segmento. De acordo com dados divulgados pelo Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais ( Centrorochas ), no ano passado o país faturou 1,34 bilhões de dólares. Entre janeiro e dezembro, o setor nacional enviou 2,4 milhões de toneladas para 132 países distribuídos nos cinco continentes e bateu crescimento de 35,5% com relação a 2020. Um dos grandes motivos para a grande alta é a maior segurança dos empresários em exportar seus produtos após a assinatura do convênio setorial firmado entre o Centrorochas e a Agência Brasileira de Promoção de Exportações e Investimentos ( ApexBrasil ). Juntas, as duas entidades desenvolvem o It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone , projeto de incentivo às exportações do setor que atualmente apoia cerca de 140 empresas. Os Estados Unidos aparecem na liderança como maior consumidor representando 62,7% de todas as exportações. China (11,5%), Itália (6,5%) e México (3,8%) ocupam as posições seguintes. Os quatro países fazem parte dos oito mercados-alvo apontados pelo projeto setorial. “Em um ano com sérias complexidades logísticas, o setor de rochas nacional bateu esse recorde histórico. A credibilidade do Centrorochas junto aos empresários, somada ao cenário mais ameno da pandemia no segundo semestre de 2021, ao desenvolvimento das ações do projeto setorial e ainda ao aquecimento do setor de construção civil mundial, contribuiu para este avanço. Superamos em quase 40 milhões de dólares o nosso maior faturamento até então, que havia sido registrado em 2013.”, detalhou o presidente do Centrorochas, Tales Machado. “O ano de 2021 foi repleto de desafios, mas juntos soubemos transformá-los em oportunidades e vitórias. É gratificante ver que nossa parceria com o setor de rochas ornamentais produziu recordes nas exportações e, por consequência, gerou mais empregos e renda em benefício de milhares de famílias brasileiras”, afirmou o presidente da ApexBrasil, Augusto Pestana. Maiores estados exportadores Espírito Santo (83,3%), Minas Gerais (9,9%) e Ceará (2,8%) foram os três estados que mais exportaram rochas ornamentais de janeiro a dezembro do ano passado. O estado capixaba foi o maior exportador do segmento em 2021, acumulando um total de US$ 1,14 bilhões, respondendo por 83,3% do valor total das exportações de rochas realizadas pelo Brasil. A evolução capixaba durante o ano, em relação ao ano anterior, foi de 37,02% em valor (dólar) e 8,95% em peso (tonelada), mostrando um crescimento orgânico em valor agregado dos materiais exportados de 25,77% no preço médio (dólar/tonelada). Minas Gerais somou US$ 132,76 milhões e crescimento de 25,5% permanecendo como segunda maior potência brasileira dentre os maiores exportadores. Já o Ceará acumulou um total de US$ 37,87 milhões e 50% de crescimento nas exportações no período analisado, destaque para o envio de quartzitos, em bruto ou beneficiado. Segundo o presidente do Sindicato da Indústria de Rochas Ornamentais, Cal e Calcários do Estado do Espírito Santo ( Sindirochas ), Ed Martins, o setor é responsável por aproximadamente 10% do PIB capixaba e concentra o maior número de empresas do país, gerando cerca de 25 mil empregos diretos e 100 indiretos no estado. “A cadeira produtiva de rochas possui próximo de 1.600 empresas no Espírito Santo e 200 frentes de lavra. Quando olhamos para o mercado externo, sem deixar de atender o nosso mercado interno, uma das vantagens da nossa indústria é a sua diversidade, o que nos permite atender às necessidades de mercados com diferentes perfis”, apontou. Sobre o It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone O It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone é um programa de incentivo às exportações desenvolvido pelo Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais (Centrorochas) em parceria com a Agência Brasileira de Promoção de Exportações e Investimentos (ApexBrasil). O programa tem por objetivos estimular e aumentar as exportações de rochas ornamentais brasileiras, através de um conjunto de ações estratégicas de internacionalização com ações de promoção, fortalecimento da imagem e desenvolvimento do setor no mercado mundial. Sobre o Centrorochas O Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais atua diretamente nos trâmites relacionados à presença do empresário brasileiro no exterior combinado com atividades comerciais e operacionais relativas ao desenvolvimento e evolução das empresas brasileiras. Sobre a ApexBrasil A ApexBrasil atua para promover os produtos e serviços brasileiros no exterior e atrair investimentos estrangeiros para setores estratégicos da economia brasileira. Para alcançar esses objetivos, a Agência realiza ações diversificadas de promoção comercial que visam promover as exportações e valorizar os produtos e serviços brasileiros no exterior, como missões prospectivas e comerciais, rodadas de negócios, apoio à participação de empresas brasileiras em grandes feiras internacionais, visitas de compradores estrangeiros e formadores de opinião para conhecer a estrutura produtiva brasileira entre outras plataformas de negócios que também têm por objetivo fortalecer a marca Brasil. texto: The Coordinator of sectoral projects at ApexBrasil (Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency), Paulo Roberto da Silva, and Analyst Emerson Raiol visited Espírito Santo between December 7th and 9th, when they had the opportunity to get to know the reality of the productive arrangement of dimension stones. The program included meetings in Vitória, Vila Velha, Serra and Cachoeiro de Itapemirim. The Agency and Centrorochas (Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Pedras Ornamentais) are partners in the execution of It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone, a sectoral project that aims to stimulate and increase exports of Brazilian ornamental stones. The state of Espírito Santo was chosen for the visit because it is the largest national exporter in the segment and has the highest concentration of companies per square meter. In addition to visiting companies in the sector, the agenda included strategic meetings such as a visit to a port terminal and a chat about the new Vitória Stone Fair. The president of Centrorochas, Tales Machado; the deputy, Fabio Cruz; the executive director, Celmo de Freitas; the project manager, Rogério Ribeiro; the relationship manager, Mila Romanelli; and the communication advisor, Karina Porto Firme. Learn more about visits: Day 01 (07/12 – Vila Velha and Vitória) – TVV The agenda was opened by a visit to the Port Terminal of Vila Velha, TVV, operated by Log-in Logística Intermodal. In a guided tour, the commercial executive of the port, Daniel Correa, presented the local structure, processes and planned improvements, such as the installation of two new cranes in January 2022. Of German origin, each machine supports up to 150 tons (the current holds up to 45 tons). The improvement will make boarding and disembarking processes even more agile. – Management Committee The first It’s Natural management committee meeting was held in a hybrid format. At the opening, the ApexBrasil Project Manager, Emerson Raiol, highlighted the importance of the visit and spoke about the relevance of the national stone sector. In his participation, coordinator Paulo Roberto da Silva, emphasized that the segment has always been active in promoting its products, crossing borders in search of new customers and potential markets. Management committee members participating in the meeting: Daniel Salume, Gabriel Cabeza, Gustavo Probst, Leonardo Tatagiba, Cristiani Mineti, Renan Catelan and Tales Machado. The agenda also included the participation of the project manager, Rogério Ribeiro, and the executive director, Celmo de Freitas. Subjects on the agenda discussed by the participating group: details of the ApexBrasil visit agenda; project participation in the Kbis 2022 fair; forecast for the launch of the public notice for personalized actions; accountability balance sheet and audit forecast; draw and next steps for Coverings 2022. – Victoria Stone Fair In a meeting at the headquarters of Milanez & Milaneze, the company responsible for organizing the Brazilian fairs in the stone sector Vitoria Stone Fair and Cachoeiro Stone Fair, ApexBrasil members were able to learn about the new concept of the international fair that will take place from February 15 to 18, 2022 The company’s CEO, Flávia Milaneze, showed the news. Completely revamped, Vitoria Stone Fair will debut special projects focused on offering a different experience to visitors. Day 2 (12/08 – Itapemirim Waterfall) – White marble quarry The second day began with a visit to the Imil white marble quarry, one of the most traditional companies in the sector in Brazil. Operating since 1946, the company has 64 hectares of property and a mining area of 52 hectares. 100% of what is produced on site is used, whether in block, carved block, brown stone or gravel. Accompanied by the engineer Cláudio Carneiro, the visitors witnessed the overturning of a board weighing around 700 tons. – Visit to Magban Following the production process of the block, after extraction, the dimension stones go to the industry where they are processed. On a guided tour of Magban by partners Tales and Gonsalo Machado, visitors learned about the company’s production process, which has its own quarries and currently distributes its products to more than 50 countries. – Visit to Pettrus One of the forerunners in the supply of semi-precious and super exotic ornamental stones, Pettrus is characterized by the exclusivity of materials of the highest quality standards. The company’s owner, Maxwell Viquietti Alcântara, showed the modern machinery with the latest technology, such as an Italian polishing machine, one of the few existing units in Brazil. Day 3 (12/09 – Serra) – Visit to Zucchi The entrepreneurial vision and constant investment in state-of-the-art equipment was highlighted during the visit to Zucchi. The tour to the industrial area was conducted by the commercial director, Leonardo Tatagiba, who detailed the entire production process and highlighted the renovation. 100% of the machinery that will start operating by the end of March. One of the machines is already in operation, capable of carving sculptures with impressive details. – Visit to Brasilgran The visit schedule ended with a visit to Brasigran, a reference company in the sector which, with the support of its parent company, Mineração Corcovado, specialized in the extraction of exclusive exotic materials from its own deposits and with extensive operations in the foreign market, is one of the leaders national exports of sheets and finished products. The tour of the industry was guided by the commercial director, Ricardo Schevz, who presented Brasigran Home, an area dedicated to the execution of projects. texto: The Brazilian ornamental stone sector registered the best accumulated partial result, between January and November, of the last six years. The evolution of exports was 36.20% when compared to the same period last year. Until the penultimate month of this year, November, the sector had revenues of US$1.22 billion with exports of 2,213,000 tons. The data were released by Centrorochas (Brazilian Center for Ornamental Stones Exporters). The entity executes, in partnership with ApexBrasil (Brazilian Agency for the Promotion of Exports and Investments), the sectoral project It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone, which aims to stimulate and increase exports of Brazilian ornamental stones. The expectation for the segment is to close the billing of 2021, surpassing 1.31 billion dollars, resulting in the best result in the history of the sector. Considering only the penultimate month of the year, national sector exports reached US$138.24 million, up 37.86% over the same period in 2020, showing that the Brazilian productive arrangement continues with resilience, dynamism and optimism for the closing of the year. “The milder scenario of the pandemic, added to the development of actions in the sectoral project and the heating up of the global civil construction sector, were essential for this leap throughout the year. If it weren’t for all the problems faced due to the international logistics crisis with the lack of containers, the numbers would be much better”, said the president of Centrorochas, Tales Machado. Major exporting states Espírito Santo, Minas Gerais and Ceará were the three states that most exported ornamental stones throughout the year, compared to the same period last year. First in the ranking, the state of Espírito Santo evolved 37.13% in value, exporting 1.01 billion dollars; Minas reached revenues of US$121.4 million, up 14.7%. Ceará, third in the national ranking, accumulated a total of 36.1 million dollars, registering growth of 55%. Despite being in the top three for several months, the three states have different characteristics, like the main consumer markets. To give you an idea, analyzing only exports in November this year, Espírito Santo sent materials essentially to the United States (69.1%) and China (8.6%); Minas Gerais exported mainly to China (34.7%) and the United States (19.4%); while Ceará sold its production to the United States (61.4%) and Italy (33.1%). About It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone is an export incentive program developed by the Brazilian Center for Ornamental Stones Exporters (Centrorochas) in partnership with the Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency (ApexBrasil). This program aims to stimulate and increase exports of Brazilian ornamental stones, through a set of strategic internationalization actions with promotion actions, strengthening the image and development of the sector in the world market. About Centrorochas The Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Pedras Ornamentais acts directly in the procedures related to the presence of Brazilian businessmen abroad combined with commercial and operational activities related to the development and evolution of Brazilian companies. About ApexBrasil ApexBrasil acts to promote Brazilian products and services abroad and attract foreign investment to strategic sectors of the Brazilian economy. To achieve these goals, the Agency carries out diversified trade promotion actions aimed at promoting exports and valuing Brazilian products and services abroad, such as prospective and trade missions, business roundtables, support for the participation of Brazilian companies in major international fairs, visits of foreign buyers and opinion makers to get to know the Brazilian production structure, among other business platforms that also aim to strengthen the Brazil brand.

texto: The milder scenario of the pandemic and the good moment of the world stone sector has motivated Brazilian companies to resume participation in international fairs. Exactly 60 companies in the segment have confirmed their participation in the 2022 edition of Coverings, considered the largest fair in the marble and granite sector in North America, which will take place from April 5th to 8th, in Las Vegas, United States. The event to draw the areas took place on December 6th, in Vitória, Espírito Santo, and was organized by the Brazilian Center for Ornamental Stones Exporters (Centrorochas), executing entity of It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone, a sectorial project to promote Brazilian rocks in the international market, carried out in partnership with the Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency (Apex-Brasil). Representatives of companies installed in the state were gathered in person, in the auditorium of the Federation of Industries of Espírito Santo (Findes), and, virtually, those of companies located in other Brazilian states. Following pre-established criteria, companies were divided into four groups and had the opportunity to choose their stands as their names were drawn. “Although we tested several online draw platforms, we chose to do everything physically. We wanted the companies to follow the entire process and have a guarantee of the suitability of the selection”, detailed the manager of the sectoral project, Rogério Ribeiro. There’s still a chance! The Brazilian Pavilion will consist of 74 stands divided into an area of 1,780 m². There are still vacancies still available for Brazilian companies in the ornamental stone sector that are interested in participating in the event. Simply be or become an It’s Natural supported company to access the benefits. Membership is free upon signing an initial term and answering a segmentation survey. Those interested can talk to the person responsible for managing the project’s relationship, Mila Romanelli: 27 99983-5125. texto: O cenário mais ameno da pandemia e o bom momento do setor de rochas mundial tem motivado as empresas brasileiras a retomarem participação nas feiras internacionais. Exatas 60 empresas do segmento confirmaram participação na edição de 2022 da Coverings , considerada a maior feira do ramo de mármore e granito da América do Norte, que acontecerá de 05 a 08 de abril, em Las Vegas, nos Estados Unidos. O evento para sorteio das áreas aconteceu no dia 06 de dezembro, em Vitória, no Espírito Santo, e foi organizado pelo Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais ( Centrorochas ), entidade executora do It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone , projeto setorial para promoção das rochas brasileiras no mercado internacional, realizado em parceria com a Agência Brasileira de Promoção de Exportações e Investimentos ( Apex-Brasil ). Estiveram reunidos de forma presencial, no auditório da Federação das Indústrias capixaba (Findes), representantes de empresas instaladas no estado, e, de forma virtual, os de empresas localizadas em outros estados brasileiros. Seguindo critérios pré-estabelecidos as empresas foram divididas em quatro grupos e tiveram oportunidade em escolher seus estandes à medida que tinham seus nomes sorteados. “Apesar de termos testado várias plataformas de sorteio online, optamos por realizar tudo de forma física. Queríamos que as empresas acompanhassem todo o processo e tivessem garantia da idoneidade da seleção”, detalhou o gestor do projeto setorial, Rogério Ribeiro. Ainda há chance! O Pavilhão Brasileiro será formado por 74 estandes divididos em uma área de 1.780 m². Ainda há vagas ainda disponíveis para empresas brasileiras do setor de rochas ornamentais que tenham interessem em participar do evento. Basta ser ou se tornar uma empresa apoiada pelo It’s Natural para ter acesso aos benefícios. A adesão é gratuita mediante assinatura de termo inicial e resposta a pesquisa de segmentação. Os interessados podem falar com a responsável pela gestão de relacionamento do projeto, Mila Romanelli: 27 99983-5125. Sobre o It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone O It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone é um programa de incentivo às exportações desenvolvido pelo Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais (Centrorochas) em parceria com a Agência Brasileira de Promoção de Exportações e Investimentos (Apex-Brasil). Este programa tem por objetivos estimular e aumentar as exportações de rochas ornamentais brasileiras, através de um conjunto de ações estratégicas de internacionalização com ações de promoção, fortalecimento da imagem e desenvolvimento do setor no mercado mundial. Sobre o Centrorochas O Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais atua diretamente nos trâmites relacionados à presença do empresário brasileiro no exterior combinado com atividades comerciais e operacionais relativas ao desenvolvimento e evolução das empresas brasileiras. Sobre a Apex-Brasil A Apex-Brasil atua para promover os produtos e serviços brasileiros no exterior e atrair investimentos estrangeiros para setores estratégicos da economia brasileira. Para alcançar esses objetivos, a Agência realiza ações diversificadas de promoção comercial que visam promover as exportações e valorizar os produtos e serviços brasileiros no exterior, como missões prospectivas e comerciais, rodadas de negócios, apoio à participação de empresas brasileiras em grandes feiras internacionais, visitas de compradores estrangeiros e formadores de opinião para conhecer a estrutura produtiva brasileira entre outras plataformas de negócios que também têm por objetivo fortalecer a marca Brasil.

texto: In October, two months before concluding the annual balance of exports, the Brazilian ornamental stone sector recorded revenues of US$ 1 billion from national exports, surpassing the amount achieved throughout 2020. The growth recorded from January to October was of 36%, in relation to the same period last year and was released by the Brazilian Center of Ornamental Stones Exporters (Centrorochas). The United States was the main destination for Brazilian products. The American market represented approximately 62.9% of exports. Considering only manufactured products, exports to the country jumped to 78.3% of the total exported by Brazil. The world’s main supplier of ornamental stones to the United States in 2020, Brazil, through Brazilian companies in the sector, is already preparing to participate in the largest fair in the marble and granite sector in North America, Coverings, which will take place in April 2022 in Las Vegas. texto: Marble makers from all over Brazil and one from Cape Verde gathered at the Stone Connection, held in the southern region of Espírito Santo from October 27th to 31st. The president of Centrorochas, Tales Machado, participated in the Panel with Entities from the Stone Sector, on the 29th, alongside the president of Sindirochas, Ed Martins, and businesswoman Renata Malenza, with mediation by Katiane Passos, businesswoman and organizer of the event. The Stone Connection brought together, in Cachoeiro de Itapemirim, marble factories with the intention of sharing their experiences and knowledge, debating and presenting new strategies for business, the future of professions and education, boosting their businesses. “Moments like this are uniquely rich for the segment. They also serve to direct the work of entities such as what companies need”, said Tales Machado. “The event was wonderful. I am very happy to see initiatives like this where values are added for the common good”, added Ed Martins. The event was organized by businesswoman Katiane Passos, who has been working in the natural stone segment since 1994. In addition to her routine as a businesswoman at the head of Nordeste Mármores, Katiane leads the Stone Woman group, with more than 130 women marble workers.

texto: Liderados pelo presidente do Centrorochas , Tales Machado, e pelo vice-presidente do Sinrochas-MG , José Balbino, uma comitiva de empresários do setor de rochas ornamentais nacional participou na sexta-feira, 22 de outubro, da homenagem concedida ao novo diretor da Agência Nacional de Mineração ( ANM ), Guilherme Santana Gomes; servidor de carreira nomeado para ocupar uma das cinco cadeiras da direção do órgão de regulação. O evento foi articulado pelo Centrorochas, Sinrochas-MG, e contou com apoio das federações das indústrias de Minas Gerais, FIEMG, do Espírito Santo, FINDES , e do Sindirochas-ES . A solenidade aconteceu em Belo Horizonte, na sede da FIEMG. Participaram o presidente da federação mineira, Flávio Roscoe, a presidente da Findes, Cristhine Samorini, o presidente do Sindirochas-ES, Ed Martins, o presidente do Sinrochas, Eduardo Félix, além de lideranças políticas, como os deputados federais Evair de Melo e Josias Da Vitória.

texto: On a visit to Espírito Santo this Thursday, October 14, the Consul General of the Republic of Argentina in Rio de Janeiro, Claudio Gutierrez, and the 1st Secretary of the Economic and Commercial Section of the Argentine Embassy in Brasília, Alfredo Curi, were received by 1st vice-president of Findes, Paulo Baraona, and by the president of Centrorochas, Tales Machado, during a visit for commercial approximation. The meeting took place at the building of the federation of industries in Espírito Santo, in Vitória, and was attended by the executive business manager, Cícero Grams, and the specialist from the International Business Center (CIN-ES), Gustavo Nunes, who gave a presentation on the potentialities of Espírito Santo, highlighting, among other points, its strength in international trade. Representing the president of Findes, Cris Samorini, Baraona highlighted the logistical vocation of the State, as well as its strength in foreign trade with products such as iron ore, ornamental rocks and oil and gas. “We are at a time when the private initiative needs to take care of politics a little and work in partnership with the public power for economic growth, job creation and reduction of social difficulties”, he stressed. “We have cooperation agreements signed with several institutions, all with aligned objectives that benefit both parties. Our focus is on increasing exports of goods and services. We got to know several products from Espírito Santo, among them, the marble and granite produced here”, added the consul. Largest exporter of ornamental stones in the country, Espírito Santo was responsible, in 2020, for about 30% of Argentine imports of ornamental stones. “Last year, we accumulated revenues of US$4.2 million from exports to Argentina. This year, until September, Brazil has revenues of 5.2 billion dollars with sales there”, highlighted Tales Machado.

texto: Em visita ao Espírito Santo nesta quinta-feira, 14 de outubro, o Cônsul Geral da República da Argentina no Rio de Janeiro, Claudio Gutierrez, e o 1º Secretário da Seção Econômica e Comercial da Embaixada Argentina em Brasília, Alfredo Curi, foram recebidos pelo 1º vice-presidente da Findes , Paulo Baraona, e pelo presidente do Centrorochas , Tales Machado, durante visita para aproximação comercial. O encontro aconteceu no edifício da federação das indústrias capixaba, em Vitória, e contou com a presença do gerente executivo de negócios, Cícero Grams, e do especialista do Centro Internacional de Negócios (CIN-ES), Gustavo Nunes, que fez uma apresentação sobre as potencialidades do Espírito Santo, destacando, entre outros pontos, sua força no comércio internacional. Representando a presidente da Findes, Cris Samorini, Baraona destacou a vocação logística do Estado, bem como sua força no comércio exterior com produtos como minério de ferro, rochas ornamentais e óleo e gás. “Estamos em um momento em que a iniciativa privada precisa cuidar um pouco da política e trabalhar em parceria com o poder público para crescimento da economia, geração de emprego e diminuição das dificuldades sociais”, frisou. “Temos acordos de cooperação firmados com várias instituições, todos com objetivos alinhados que beneficiam ambas as partes. Nosso foco é aumentar as exportações de bens e serviços. Conhecemos vários produtos capixabas, dentre eles, os mármores e granitos produzidos aqui”, completou o cônsul. Maior exportador de rochas ornamentais do país, o Espírito Santo foi responsável, em 2020, por cerca de 30% das importações argentinas de rochas ornamentais. “No ano passado, acumulamos um faturamento de 4,2 milhões de dólares com as exportações para a Argentina. Este ano, até setembro, o Brasil soma faturamento de 5,2 bilhões de dólares com as vendas para lá”, destacou Tales Machado.

texto: In a periodic meeting held on October 13, the Management Committee of It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone monitored the balance of activities carried out during the first four months of execution and the presentation of actions planned for the coming months. The project is an initiative led by the Brazilian Center for Ornamental Stones Exporters (Centrorochas) and the Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency (Apex-Brasil) to promote Brazilian stones in the international market. The group was created with the aim of taking care of the strategies of the sectoral agreement signed between the two entities and is composed of leaders from 11 companies, with representation in five states: Espírito Santo, Bahia, Pernambuco, Minas Gerais and Ceará. Held virtually, the meeting was conducted by project managers, Emerson Raiol (Apex-Brasil) and Rogério Ribeiro (Centrorochas). At the opening, the representative of the national agency stressed the importance of alignment with the Management Committee. “We are closing the first installment of the project (6 months) so it is necessary to analyze the results of the actions carried out, as well as define the actions for 2022, taking into account the expectations of the entities (Apex-Brasil and Centrorochas ) and participating companies”, he reinforced. The rendering of accounts was divided into two stages: details of the actions (performed, in progress and those planned for the next year) as well as a balance of the expenses incurred. Next planned actions: – Designer in Brazil and Image projects at Vitoria Stone Fair 2022 (from 15 to 18 February 2022, in Espírito Santo – Brazil) – Coverings 2022 (from April 5 to 8, 2022, in Las Vegas – United States) – Stone Expor (from 01 to 03 February, in Las Vegas – United States) – Kbis (February 8th to 10th – Orlando – United States) – Expo 2020 (Dubai, United Arab Emirates) Management Committee members present at the meeting: Tales Machado, Ricardo Schevz, Leonardo Tatagiba, David Silveira, Gabriel Cabeza, Daniel Salume and Renan Catelan. Centrorochas vice-president, Fabio Cruz, and executive director, Celmo de Freitas, also participated in the meeting. About It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone is an export incentive program developed by the Brazilian Center for Ornamental Stones Exporters (Centrorochas) in partnership with the Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency (Apex-Brasil). This program aims to stimulate and increase exports of Brazilian ornamental stones, through a set of strategic internationalization actions with promotion actions, strengthening the image and development of the sector in the world market. About Centrorochas The Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Pedras Ornamentais acts directly in the procedures related to the presence of Brazilian businessmen abroad combined with commercial and operational activities related to the development and evolution of Brazilian companies. About Apex-Brasil Apex-Brasil acts to promote Brazilian products and services abroad and attract foreign investment to strategic sectors of the Brazilian economy. To achieve these goals, the Agency carries out diversified trade promotion actions aimed at promoting exports and valuing Brazilian products and services abroad, such as prospective and trade missions, business roundtables, support for the participation of Brazilian companies in major international fairs, visits of foreign buyers and opinion makers to get to know the Brazilian production structure, among other business platforms that also aim to strengthen the Brazil brand.

texto: Em reunião periódica realizada no dia 13 de outubro, o Comitê Gestor do It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone acompanhou o balanço das atividades realizadas durante os quatro primeiros meses de execução e a apresentação das ações previstas para os próximos meses. O projeto é uma iniciativa liderada pelo Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais ( Centrorochas ) e a Agência Brasileira de Promoção de Exportações e Investimentos ( Apex-Brasil ) para promoção das rochas brasileiras no mercado internacional. O grupo foi criado com o intuito de cuidar das estratégias do convênio setorial firmado entre as duas entidades e é composto por lideranças de 11 empresas, com representação em cinco estados: Espírito Santo, Bahia, Pernambuco, Minas Gerais e Ceará. Realizada de forma virtual, a reunião foi conduzida pelos gestores do projeto, Emerson Raiol (Apex-Brasil) e Rogério Ribeiro (Centrorochas). Na abertura, o representante da agência nacional frisou sobre a importância do alinhamento com o Comitê Gestor. “Estamos encerrando a primeira parcela do projeto (6 meses) de forma que faz-se necessário analisar os resultados das ações realizadas, bem como definirmos sobre as ações para 2022, levando-se em consideração as expectativas das entidades (Apex-Brasil e Centrorochas) e empresas participantes”, reforçou. A prestação de contas foi dividida em dois momentos: detalhamento das ações (realizadas, em andamento e aquelas previstas para próximo ano) bem como balanço dos gastos realizados. Próximas ações previstas: – Projetos Designer in Brazil e Imagem na Vitoria Stone Fair 2022 (de 15 a 18 de fevereiro de 2022, no Espírito Santo – Brasil) – Coverings 2022 (de 05 a 08 de abril de 2022, em Las Vegas – Estados Unidos) – Stone Expor (de 01 a 03 de fevereiro, em Las Vegas – Estados Unidos) – Kbis (08 a 10 de fevereiro – Orlando – Estados Unidos) – Expo 2020 (Dubai, Emirados Árabes Unidos) Membros do Comitê Gestor presentes na reunião: Tales Machado, Ricardo Schevz, Leonardo Tatagiba, David Silveira, Gabriel Cabeza, Daniel Salume e Renan Catelan. O vice-presidente do Centrorochas, Fabio Cruz, e o diretor executivo, Celmo de Freitas, também participou do encontro. Sobre o It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone O It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone é um programa de incentivo às exportações desenvolvido pelo Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais (Centrorochas) em parceria com a Agência Brasileira de Promoção de Exportações e Investimentos (Apex-Brasil). Este programa tem por objetivos estimular e aumentar as exportações de rochas ornamentais brasileiras, através de um conjunto de ações estratégicas de internacionalização com ações de promoção, fortalecimento da imagem e desenvolvimento do setor no mercado mundial. Sobre o Centrorochas O Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais atua diretamente nos trâmites relacionados à presença do empresário brasileiro no exterior combinado com atividades comerciais e operacionais relativas ao desenvolvimento e evolução das empresas brasileiras. Sobre a Apex-Brasil A Apex-Brasil atua para promover os produtos e serviços brasileiros no exterior e atrair investimentos estrangeiros para setores estratégicos da economia brasileira. Para alcançar esses objetivos, a Agência realiza ações diversificadas de promoção comercial que visam promover as exportações e valorizar os produtos e serviços brasileiros no exterior, como missões prospectivas e comerciais, rodadas de negócios, apoio à participação de empresas brasileiras em grandes feiras internacionais, visitas de compradores estrangeiros e formadores de opinião para conhecer a estrutura produtiva brasileira entre outras plataformas de negócios que também têm por objetivo fortalecer a marca Brasil.

titulo: Debate on the User Guide highlights the importance of the document for the Brazilian stone sector
resumo: At the invitation of Insight Educação Executivo, the president of Centrorochas, Tales Machado, participated in the chat about the User Guide, alongside the director of the National Mining Agency (ANM), Guilherme Gomes, on Wednesday, October 13th. With a live broadcast on Youtube and mediated by Sônia Greco, the event addressed the importance of the document for the private sector, mainly for the stone sector, the current status of the applicable regulations, the reflections of ANM Resolution 37/2020 in everyday life practices of mining enterprises and the internal understandings standardized i
texto: At the invitation of Insight Educação Executivo, the president of Centrorochas, Tales Machado, participated in the chat about the User Guide, alongside the director of the National Mining Agency (ANM), Guilherme Gomes, on Wednesday, October 13th. With a live broadcast on Youtube and mediated by Sônia Greco, the event addressed the importance of the document for the private sector, mainly for the stone sector, the current status of the applicable regulations, the reflections of ANM Resolution 37/2020 in everyday life practices of mining enterprises and the internal understandings standardized in the ANM. “If it weren’t for GU, Brazil wouldn’t be the 5th largest producer and exporter of ornamental stones. There have been great advances, but the adopted model needs to evolve”, explained Tales Machado during his participation. “The mismatch between the only renewal of the GU and the issuance of the mining concession could lead to a collapse in the ornamental stone sector. The main bottlenecks of the national productive arrangement are the limitation of only one renewal of the permit and the fact that there is no deadline for responding to the document’s application”, he detailed. The director of ANM highlighted that “different procedures are needed for different production scales and not for types of products”, he stressed. Guilherme Santana also warned that the states of Minas Gerais and Espírito Santo could see their processes blocked due to a paragraph in article 24. “This text, which determines the issuance of only two User Guides, will block the processes in Minas and Espírito Santo. This correction is not the responsibility of the agency, if it were, we would have already resolved it.”, he asked. The event had the active participation of viewers via chat. Among the participants was the director of ANM, Débora Tocci. Click here and review the webinar: https://youtu.be/N8vnTa3Mxj4

texto: A convite da Insight Educação Executiva , o presidente do Centrorochas , Tales Machado, participou do bate-papo sobre Guia de Utilização, ao lado o diretor da Agência Nacional de Mineração ( ANM ), Guilherme Gomes, na quarta-feira, 13 de outubro. Com transmissão ao vivo pelo Youtube e mediado por Sônia Greco, o evento abordou a importância do documento para o setor privado, principalmente para o setor de rochas, o estado atual da regulamentação aplicável, os reflexos da Resolução ANM 37/2020 no dia a dia prático dos empreendimentos minerários e os entendimentos internos padronizados na ANM. “Se não fosse a GU, o Brasil não seria o 5º maior produtor e exportador de rochas ornamentais. Houve grandes avanços, mas é preciso evoluir o modelo adotado”, explicou Tales Machado durante sua participação. “O descompasso entre a única renovação da GU e a emissão da concessão de lavra pode gerar um colapso no setor de rochas ornamentais. Os principais gargalos do arranjo produtivo nacional são a limitação de apenas uma renovação da guia e o fato de não ter prazo para resposta do requerimento do documento”, detalhou. O diretor da ANM destacou que “são necessários procedimentos diversos para diversas escalas produtivas e não por tipos de produtos”, frisou. Guilherme Santana ainda alertou que os estados de Minas Gerais e Espírito Santo poderão ver seus processos travados devido a parágrafo no artigo 24. “Esse texto, que determina emissão de apenas duas Guias de Utilização, vai travar os processos em Minas e no Espírito Santo. Essa correção não é atribuição da agência, se fosse, já teríamos resolvido.”, pediu. O evento contou com participação ativa dos telespectadores via chat. Entre os participantes estava a diretora da ANM, Débora Tocci. Clique aqui e reveja o webinar: https://youtu.be/N8vnTa3Mxj4

texto: The president of the Brazilian Center for Dimension Stone Exporters (Centrorochas), Tales Machado, the vice-president, Fabio Cruz, and the manager of the sectorial project It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone, Rogério Ribeiro, participated in the opening of the 2022 Strategic Alignment Workshop organized by the Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency (Apex-Brasil) for partner entities. Held in São Paulo, the workshop was attended by the agency’s president, Augusto Pestana, who highlighted the need for everyone to unite and form partnerships to maximize sectors. “It is fundamental that we explore our convergences more and more”, he said, reinforcing the importance of the presence of Brazil and national products in the world market, in addition to the need to evolve the management tools and execution of agreements in these new times of pandemic. Apex-Brasil’s director of corporate management, Roberto Escoto, presented the digital transformation the agency has undergone. “The pandemic has enhanced the importance of digital transformation in all companies and, for us, it was no different, not least because the agency needs to lead certain movements”, he pointed out before detailing the processes that were modernized. The importance of entities as replicators of actions and the importance of Apex-Brasil was exalted by the agency’s business director, Lucas Fiuza, who also addressed the power of integration ‘exports and investments’ and union between public and private sectors. “Brazil has changed, we live in a totally different business environment. We are no longer the country of the future, but of the present”, he pointed out. When presenting Apex-Brasil’s intelligence planning for 2022, the market intelligence manager, Igor Celeste, reinforced the integration of all in the coordination of efforts to share information and knowledge. “This union is fundamental because we have big challenges. Our intelligence planning spans 15 focus countries. Some of these locations have Apex-Brasil offices and are commercial hubs, but the fact is that sectorial projects are of great importance in the development of this productive value chain”, he detailed. In his speech, the Chief of Staff of the Foreign Trade and Economic Affairs Secretariat of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Joaquim Penna, spoke about the new structure that divided the sectors into similar areas and reinforced President Pestana’s words about the need for unity ‘ public versus private’. “We need to increase exports and increase the added value of Brazilian products”, he stressed, completing the importance of using commercial intelligence and integration with local entities when working with the foreign market. “The world does not know the energy matrix of Brazil’s production chain, which is the best among the 20 main economies”, he pointed out. The president of Centrorochas, Tales Machado, was one of the associated entities to demonstrate. In addition to thanking the national agency for its partnership, he pointed out the lack of containers that has been affecting the sector. “First, I would like to thank Apex-Brasil for all the partnership and work it has been carrying out with the national productive sectors. The Brazilian rock sector ranks first in the world in terms of geological diversity. We are the fifth largest producer and exporter in the world and we want to go further. We rely on this partnership to further promote our products and contribute to Brazil’s image abroad. We have been suffering from the lack of containers that has been affecting the shipment of our materials abroad, but despite this difficulty, the sector managed to increase exports. We had, this year, the best first semester of the last five years”, he concluded. About It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone is an export incentive program developed by the Brazilian Center for Ornamental Stones Exporters (Centrorochas) in partnership with the Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency (Apex-Brasil). This program aims to increase exports of Brazilian ornamental stones, through a set of strategic internationalization actions with promotion actions, strengthening the image and development of the sector in the world market. About Centrorochas The Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Pedras Ornamentais acts directly in the procedures related to the presence of Brazilian businessmen abroad combined with commercial and operational activities related to the development and evolution of Brazilian companies. About Apex-Brasil Apex-Brasil acts to promote Brazilian products and services abroad and attract foreign investment to strategic sectors of the Brazilian economy. To achieve these goals, the Agency carries out diversified trade promotion actions aimed at promoting exports and adding value to products.and Brazilian services abroad, such as prospective and commercial missions, business roundtables, support for the participation of Brazilian companies in major international fairs, visits by foreign buyers and opinion makers to learn about the Brazilian productive structure, among other business platforms that also aim to aim to strengthen the Brazil brand.

texto: O presidente do Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais ( Centrorochas ), Tales Machado, o vice-presidente, Fabio Cruz, e o gestor do projeto setorial It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone , Rogério Ribeiro, participaram no dia 05 de outubro da abertura do Workshop de Alinhamento Estratégico 2022 organizado pela Agência Brasileira de Promoção de Exportações e Investimentos ( Apex-Brasil ) para as entidades conveniadas. Realizado em São Paulo, o workshop contou com a presença do presidente da agência, Augusto Pestana que destacou a necessidade de união de todos e formação de parcerias para maximizar os setores. “É fundamental explorarmos, cada vez mais, nossas convergências”, afirmou ao reforçar a importância da presença do Brasil e dos produtos nacionais no mercado mundial, além da necessidade de evolução das ferramentas de gestão e execução dos convênios nesses novos tempos de pandemia. O diretor de gestão corporativa da Apex-Brasil, Roberto Escoto, apresentou a transformação digital pela qual a agência passou. “A pandemia potencializou a importância da transformação digital em todas as empresas e, para nós, não foi diferente, até mesmo porque a agência precisa liderar certos movimentos”, pontuou antes de detalhar os processos que foram modernizados. A importância das entidades como replicadoras das ações e da importância da Apex-Brasil foi exaltada pelo diretor de negócios da agência, Lucas Fiuza, que abordou ainda o poder da integração ‘exportação e investimentos’ e união entre o público e o privado. “O Brasil mudou, vivemos um ambiente de negócios totalmente diferente. Não somos mais o país do futuro, mas do presente”, pontuou. Ao apresentar o planejamento de inteligência da Apex-Brasil para 2022, o gerente de inteligência de mercado, Igor Celeste, reforçou a integração de todos na coordenação de esforços para compartilhar informação e conhecimento. “Essa união é fundamental porque nós temos desafios grandes. Nosso planejamento de inteligência abrange 15 países focais. Algumas dessas localidades contam com escritórios da Apex-Brasil e são hubs comerciais, mas o fato é que os projetos setoriais têm grande importância no desenvolvimento dessa cadeia de valor produtiva”, detalhou. Em seu pronunciamento, o Chefe de Gabinete da Secretaria de Comércio Exterior e Assuntos Econômicos do Ministério das Relações Exteriores, Joaquim Penna, falou sobre a nova estrutura que dividiu os setores em áreas afins e reforçou as palavras do presidente Pestana sobre a necessidade de união ‘público x privado’. “Precisamos aumentar as exportações e aumentar o valor agregado dos produtos brasileiros”, frisou completando a importância da utilização de inteligência comercial e integração com entidades locais ao se trabalhar com o mercado externo. “O mundo não conhece a matriz energética da cadeia produtiva do Brasil, que é a melhor entre as 20 principais economias”, pontuou. O presidente do Centrorochas, Tales Machado, foi uma das entidades conveniadas a se manifestarem. Além de agradecer a parceria da agência nacional, ele pontuou sobre a falta de contêineres que vem afetando o setor. “Primeiro, gostaria de agradecer à Apex-Brasil por toda parceria e trabalho que vem realizando com os setores produtivos nacionais. O setor de rochas brasileiro ocupa o primeiro lugar mundial em diversidade geológica. Somos o quinto maior produtor e exportador mundial e queremos ir além. Contamos com esta parceria para promover ainda mais nossos produtos e contribuir com a imagem do Brasil no exterior. Temos sofrido com a falta de contêineres que vem afetando o envio de nossos materiais para o exterior, mas apesar desta dificuldade, o setor conseguiu aumentar as exportações. Tivemos, este ano, o melhor primeiro semestre dos últimos cinco anos”, concluiu. texto: After a two-year hiatus without a face-to-face edition, companies in the ornamental stone sector came together again at the most important world fair for the supply chain and value of natural stone, Marmomac. The 2021 edition, held from September 29 to October 2, in Verona, Italy, brought together 12 Brazilian companies in an action organized directly by the Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency (Apex-Brasil), with support from the It’s Natural project – Brazilian Natural Stone. The president of the Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Pedras Ornamentais (Centrorochas), executing entity of the sectoral project, Tales Machado, and the manager of It’s Natural, Rogério Ribeiro, participated in the event and said that all the companies present were very satisfied with the return of fair. “Like in other years, this was an edition with a smaller audience, but that did not lose its shine, as the visits made were qualified, generating excellent contacts and business”, explained Tales. Companies present at the Brazilian Pavilion: Amagran, Angramar, Brasigran, Decolores, Fortuna, Granipex, Imetame, Magban, Mameri, Margramar, Montenegro and Poliex. Action with Brazilian businessmen On September 29, after the opening of Marmomac, It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone, with the support of Milanez & Milaneze and promotion from Centrorochas and Apex-Brasil, held an integration and welcome dinner for the Brazilian delegation. The meeting took place at Caffè Dante. Among those present were Tales Machado, president of Centrorochas, Rogério Ribeiro, manager of It’s Natural, Paulo Roberto Silva, project coordinator at Apex-Brasil, Silvio Gori, representative of the Brazilian consulate in Milan, Matteo Gelmetti, vice president of Veronafiere, Flávia Milanez, CEO of Milanez & Milaneze, Alessandro Giolai – M&M Board of Directors. About It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone is an export incentive program developed by the Brazilian Center for Ornamental Stones Exporters (Centrorochas) in partnership with the Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency (Apex-Brasil). This program aims to increase exports of Brazilian ornamental stones, through a set of strategic internationalization actions with promotion actions, strengthening the image and development of the sector in the world market. About Centrorochas The Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Pedras Ornamentais acts directly in the procedures related to the presence of Brazilian businessmen abroad combined with commercial and operational activities related to the development and evolution of Brazilian companies. About Apex-Brasil Apex-Brasil acts to promote Brazilian products and services abroad and attract foreign investment to strategic sectors of the Brazilian economy. To achieve these goals, the Agency carries out diversified trade promotion actions aimed at promoting exports and valuing Brazilian products and services abroad, such as prospective and trade missions, business roundtables, support for the participation of Brazilian companies in major international fairs, visits of foreign buyers and opinion makers to get to know the Brazilian production structure, among other business platforms that also aim to strengthen the Brazil brand. The event took place this Tuesday, September 21, and had the participation of the manager of the It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone project, Rogério Ribeiro. During his speech, Rogério highlighted the actions of the sectoral project, the result of the agreement signed between Centrorochas and Apex-Brasil, which aims to promote the segment in the international market. “India is one of the eight priority markets to be worked on in the next two years, the period of the project, and we have specific actions for the country, such as a market opening study, scheduled for the first half of next year”, he announced referring to to the action that involves study, prospective mission, presentation webinar and commercial mission to the country. Apex-Brasil’s specialist in Market Intelligence, Ulisses Pimenta, was another guest panelist and highlighted the grandeur of the Indian market. “India is the fastest growing economy in the world and buys ornamental stones from several countries, with Turkey and Italy as the main suppliers and Brazil occupies the 6th position in this market”, he said. The executive manager of Economic Advisory at Banco do Brasil, Vinicius Zanchi, presented the scenario of the national and world economies that the BB team has signaled for the end of 2021 and for next year. “We see a scenario of economic recovery amid risks. The international economic scenario is still favorable, but from now on, if we had to weigh the risks, they are asymmetrical. On the domestic side, the position is also one of caution, considering the scenario of reforms and the entry into an election year”, he pointed out. At the end of the event, BB’s International Business manager, Murilo Almeida, presented the lines offered by the bank that benefit the ornamental stone sector, such as PROEX Financing, which, in 2021, will complete 30 years. “This is a financing program to support Brazilian exports of goods and services, at costs compatible with those practiced in the international market”, he exemplified. texto: A Live Comex, organizada pelo Banco do Brasil , com participação do Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais ( Centrorochas ) e da Agência Brasileira de Promoção de Exportações e Investimentos ( Apex-Brasil ) destacou oportunidades para as empresas brasileiras no mercado indiano. O evento aconteceu nesta terça-feira, 21 de setembro, e contou com a participação do gerente do projeto It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone , Rogério Ribeiro. Durante sua intervenção, Rogério destacou as ações do projeto setorial, resultado do convênio firmado entre o Centrorochas e a Apex-Brasil, que visa promover o segmento no mercado internacional. “A Índia é um dos oito mercados prioritários a serem trabalhados nos próximos dois anos, período do projeto, e temos ações específicas para o país como um estudo de abertura de mercado, previsto para o primeiro semestre do ano que vem”, anunciou referindo-se à ação que envolve estudo, missão prospectiva, webinário de apresentação e missão comercial ao país. O especialista em Inteligência de Mercado da Apex-Brasil, Ulisses Pimenta, foi outro painelista convidado e destacou a grandiosidade do mercado indiano. “A Índia é a economia que mais cresce no mundo e compra rochas ornamentais de vários países, tendo Turquia e Itália como principais fornecedores e o Brasil ocupa a 6ª posição desse mercado”, afirmou. O gerente executivo de Assessoramento Econômico do Banco do Brasil, Vinicius Zanchi, apresentou o cenário das economias nacional e mundial que o time do BB tem sinalizado para o final de 2021 e para o ano que vem. “Vemos um cenário de recuperação econômica em meio a riscos. O cenário econômico internacional ainda é favorável, mas, daqui pra frente, se tivemos que ponderar os riscos, eles são assimétricos. No lado doméstico, a posição também é de cautela, considerando o cenário de reformas e a entrada em ano de eleições”, apontou. Para alcançar esses objetivos, a Agência realiza ações diversificadas de promoção comercial que visam promover as exportações e valorizar os produtos e serviços brasileiros no exterior, como missões prospectivas e comerciais, rodadas de negócios, apoio à participação de empresas brasileiras em grandes feiras internacionais, visitas de compradores estrangeiros e formadores de opinião para conhecer a estrutura produtiva brasileira entre outras plataformas de negócios que também têm por objetivo fortalecer a marca Brasil.

titulo: Brazilian stone sector closes 2nd quarter with 39% increase in exports
resumo: Despite being suffering from the effects of lack of space on ships and availability of containers since the beginning of the year, the national ornamental stone sector celebrates the result obtained with exports until August. According to data from the Brazilian Center of Dimension Stone Exporters (Centrorochas), released this week, at the end of the second quarter of 2021, the Brazilian natural stone segment closed exports with an evolution of 39.34%, compared to the same period of the year past, accumulating U$S 831.8 million in direct sales and 1.5 million tons of shipped products. Emphasis
texto: Despite being suffering from the effects of lack of space on ships and availability of containers since the beginning of the year, the national ornamental stone sector celebrates the result obtained with exports until August. According to data from the Brazilian Center of Dimension Stone Exporters (Centrorochas), released this week, at the end of the second quarter of 2021, the Brazilian natural stone segment closed exports with an evolution of 39.34%, compared to the same period of the year past, accumulating U$S 831.8 million in direct sales and 1.5 million tons of shipped products. Emphasis on sales of marble blocks and similar, slabs and other marble pieces, growing compared to the previous year, respectively, 78.86% and 51.42%, in the accumulated result for the year, showing an increase in the international demand for these materials. In August, the United States, one of the eight priority markets for It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone, a project resulting from the sectoral agreement signed between Centrorochas and the Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency (Apex-Brasil) with the aim of expand exports of Brazilian dimension stones in the international market, remained in the lead of the most frequent destinations for Brazilian products, accounting for approximately 50.6% of exports. According to data from the Foreign Trade Statistics Report, by the Ministry of Economy, the port most used for the disposal of processed materials in August was Rio de Janeiro (110.3 thousand tons), representing 76% of all material sent to the international market, followed by the Port of Santos, responsible for 15% and 21.37 thousand tons of the total. The Port of Vitória, in Espírito Santo, was responsible for 65% of the shipment of raw materials, accumulating 42.57 thousand tons of natural rocks, while Fortaleza shipped 14% of the total and 9.4 thousand tons. “Centrorochas has been working in partnership with Sindirochas, the largest employers’ union in the sector in the country, together with the actors involved in the process of exporting exports, as well as with public authorities, in the search for solutions that in the short term can reduce the effects felt. In June of this year, we carried out a survey among businessmen which pointed to an impact of around 35% on the volume exported in that month. The expectation is that this situation will only be resolved in 2022, but, despite all the scenario, Brazilian exporters have been resilient and contributed to the record of excellent numbers for the country”, pointed out Tales Machado, president of Centrorochas. Major exporting states In partnership with the Union of Dimension Stones, Lime and Limestones of Espírito Santo (Sindirochas), Centrorochas also released data by region. In August, Espírito Santo maintained its leadership as the largest exporter in Brazil, registering US$ 118.4 million, concentrating approximately 84.7% of all sales made abroad; of these, 75% have the United States as their destination. Minas Gerais follows as the second largest Brazilian representative in the segment, accumulating approximately 7.7% of exports, further increasing the strength of Brazilian slates in the United Kingdom and North American markets. Espírito Santo: national rock leader Following the country’s movement, Espírito Santo evolved between January and August 2021. The state, the largest Brazilian producer and exporter, registered an increase of 39.84% in value and 9.20% in weight, showing an organic growth in added value of exported materials of 28.06% in the average price. Photo: Levantina Disclosure

titulo: Setor de rochas brasileiro fecha 2º quadrimestre com alta de 39% nas exportações
resumo: Apesar de estar sofrendo com os reflexos da falta de espaço em navios e disponibilidade de contêineres desde o início do ano, o setor de rochas ornamentais nacional comemora o resultado obtido com as exportações até agosto. Segundo dados do Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais (Centrorochas), divulgados esta semana, no término do segundo quadrimestre de 2021, o segmento de rochas naturais brasileiro fechou as exportações com evolução de 39,34%, em comparação ao mesmo período do ano passado, acumulando em vendas diretas U$S 831,8 milhões e 1,5 milhão de toneladas de produtos
texto: Apesar de estar sofrendo com os reflexos da falta de espaço em navios e disponibilidade de contêineres desde o início do ano, o setor de rochas ornamentais nacional comemora o resultado obtido com as exportações até agosto. Segundo dados do Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais ( Centrorochas ), divulgados esta semana, no término do segundo quadrimestre de 2021, o segmento de rochas naturais brasileiro fechou as exportações com evolução de 39,34%, em comparação ao mesmo período do ano passado, acumulando em vendas diretas U$S 831,8 milhões e 1,5 milhão de toneladas de produtos embarcados. Destaque para as vendas de blocos de mármores e similares, chapas e outras peças de mármores crescendo frente ao ano anterior, respectivamente, 78,86% e 51,42%, no acumulado do ano, mostrando um aumento pela demanda internacional destes materiais. Em agosto, os Estados Unidos, um dos oito mercados prioritários para atuação do It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone , projeto resultante do convênio setorial firmado entre o Centrorochas e a Agência Brasileira de Promoção de Exportações e Investimentos ( Apex-Brasil ) com o objetivo de ampliar as exportações das rochas ornamentais brasileiras no mercado internacional, permaneceram na liderança dos destinos mais frequentes dos produtos brasileiros, respondendo por aproximadamente 50,6% das exportações. Segundo dados do Relatório de Estatísticas de Comércio Exterior, do Ministério da Economia, o porto mais utilizado para escoamento dos materiais beneficiados em agosto foi o do Rio de Janeiro (110,3 mil toneladas) representando 76% de todo material enviado ao mercado internacional, seguido pelo Porto de Santos, responsável por 15% e 21,37 mil toneladas do total. Já o Porto de Vitória, no Espírito Santo, foi responsável por 65% do embarque dos materiais brutos, acumulando em 42,57 mil toneladas de rochas naturais, enquanto Fortaleza escoou 14% do total e 9,4 mil toneladas. “O Centrorochas tem atuado em parceria com o Sindirochas, maior sindicato patronal do setor no país, junto aos atores envolvidos no processo de escoamento das exportações, bem como com autoridades públicas, na busca de soluções que a curto prazo possam reduzir os efeitos sentidos. Em junho deste ano, realizamos uma pesquisa entre os empresários que apontou impacto de cerca de 35% no volume exportado naquele mês. A expectativa é que essa situação seja contornada apenas em 2022, mas, apesar de todo cenário, os exportadores brasileiros têm sido resilientes e contribuído com o registro de ótimos números para o país”, apontou Tales Machado, presidente do Centrorochas. Maiores estados exportadores Em parceria com o Sindicato da Indústria de Rochas Ornamentais, Cal e Calcários do Espírito Santo ( Sindirochas ), o Centrorochas divulgou também os dados por região. Em agosto, o Espírito Santo manteve sua liderança como maior exportador do Brasil registrando US$ 118,4 milhões, concentrando aproximadamente 84,7% de todas as vendas realizadas para o exterior; destes, 75% têm os Estados Unidos como destino. Minas Gerais vem na sequência como segundo maior representante brasileiro do segmento, acumulando aproximadamente 7,7% das exportações, elevando ainda mais a força das ardósias brasileiras nos mercados do Reino Unido e norte-americanos. Espírito Santo: líder nacional de rochas Acompanhando o movimento do país, o Espírito Santo evoluiu entre janeiro e agosto de 2021. O estado, maior produtor e exportador brasileiro, registrou alta de 39,84% em valor e 9,20% em peso, mostrando um crescimento orgânico em valor agregado dos materiais exportados de 28,06% no preço médio. texto: The president of Centrorochas, Tales Machado, was one of the panelists invited to the meeting “Espírito Santo: the prospects and opportunities of the relationship with Portugal” held this Monday, September 13, at Palácio Anchieta, in Vitória. On that occasion, a Memorandum of Understanding was signed between the State of Espírito Santo and the Portuguese Chamber of Business in the State, with the aim of discussing and articulating relevant topics, in addition to projects of mutual interest. The event was attended by the State Governor, Renato Casagrande, and the Portuguese ambassador to Brazil, Luís Faro Ramos. Mediated by the undersecretary for Investment Attraction, Gabriel Feitosa, the business panel also had the participation of the president of EDP, João Marques da Cruz, and the CEO of Borana, Jorge Aguiar. The international market set the tone for the conversation. Right at the beginning, the president of Centrorochas and vice president of Sindirochas, Tales Machado, highlighted that the Espírito Santo-Portugal agreement opens up opportunities for forming strategic and qualified partnerships that will contribute to the evolution of the stone sector as a whole and of the companies individually. “In 2020, Brazil was the eighth largest supplier of ornamental stones to Portugal, with only 1.91%. Our exports are still very small, there is room for growth. There is homework to be done, improving processes and internal structure so that we can better enjoy the moment with more longevity. The partnership recently signed between Centrorochas and Apex-Brasil, for the execution of the sectoral project, will certainly contribute to this process. The national agency shares with the sector strategic commercial intelligence information that enables previous studies for insertion in new markets and maintenance of existing ones. The results are not always immediate, but I believe that we can greatly increase our participation in this trade balance”, he declared. The event was also streamed on YouTube. As ações estão sendo organizadas pelo It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone, projeto setorial que coroou a parceria entre a Apex-Brasil e o Centrorochas. Sobre o It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone O It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone é um programa de incentivo às exportações desenvolvido pelo Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais (Centrorochas) em parceria com a Agência Brasileira de Promoção de Exportações e Investimentos (Apex-Brasil). Este programa tem por objetivo aumentar as exportações de rochas ornamentais brasileiras, através de um conjunto de ações estratégicas de internacionalização com ações de promoção, fortalecimento da imagem e desenvolvimento do setor no mercado mundial. Sobre o Centrorochas O Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais atua diretamente nos trâmites relacionados à presença do empresário brasileiro no exterior combinado com atividades comerciais e operacionais relativas ao desenvolvimento e evolução das empresas brasileiras. Sobre a Apex-Brasil A Apex-Brasil atua para promover os produtos e serviços brasileiros no exterior e atrair investimentos estrangeiros para setores estratégicos da economia brasileira. Para alcançar esses objetivos, a Agência realiza ações diversificadas de promoção comercial que visam promover as exportações e valorizar os produtos e serviços brasileiros no exterior, como missões prospectivas e comerciais, rodadas de negócios, apoio à participação de empresas brasileiras em grandes feiras internacionais, visitas de compradores estrangeiros e formadores de opinião para conhecer a estrutura produtiva brasileira entre outras plataformas de negócios que também têm por objetivo fortalecer a marca Brasil.
