texto: Diversity, quality and sustainability. These are some of the differentials of ornamental stones in Brazil that are gaining prominence in the new phase inaugurated by the national segment. This Tuesday, July 6th, the sectoral project It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone, the result of a partnership between the Brazilian Center for Ornamental Stones Exporters (Centrorochas) and the Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency (Apex-Brasil) was the subject of the premiere episode of the second season of Stone Summit. Broadcast live on Youtube and with viewers across the country, the event highlighted the objectives of the agreement, target markets, the agenda for proposed improvements, among other subjects. From a studio set up at TVV – Vila Velha Port Terminal, managed and operated by Log-In Logística Intermodal, the newly elected president of Centrorochas, Tales Machado, and vice president, Fabio Cruz, mediated the topic alongside the CEO by Milanez & Milaneze, Flávia Milaneze. The leaders of the national sectoral entity reinforced the importance of the moment and the joint work developed with the full support of businessmen. “The role of Centrorochas has been quite challenging. This chapter that begins to be written with the beginning of the sectoral project was established three years ago and intensified in the last 12 months”, detailed Fabio. “There’s a lot to be done, but we count on the primordial thing, which is the alignment with businessmen and sectoral entities for the common good of the entire national segment”, completed Tales. The debate on the actions of the sectoral project was enriched with the remote participation of businessmen and members of the management committee of the agreement signed between Centrorochas and Apex-Brasil: David Silveira (Granos), Gustavo Probst (Decolores) and Renan Catelan (Cattegran). With different performance profiles, they contributed with practical arguments from those who have experience both in the foreign and domestic markets. The first two focused on the sector’s presence in the international market, reinforcing the importance of defining the target countries established by the project. Renan, on the other hand, scored and represented the share of companies that still do not export and can also be supported by the sectoral agreement. “I still don’t export, but I’m very happy with this whole union for the good of the sector. It’s good to be part of this project and be able to be accompanied in this new challenge, which is to export, from the beginning of the process”, he said. The director of Revista Rochas deQualidade, Felipe Vampré, and the manager of the sectoral project, Rogério Ribeiro, also participated remotely and pointed out key actions of It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone. “We have to provide international specifiers with technical information. A very important action is to educate distributors, marble workers and architects so that they know the type of product they are dealing with”, emphasized Felipe. “This week, from the 7th to the 9th of July, our first action takes place, at Coverings 2021. We had little time between the signing of the agreement and the start of the fair, but we couldn’t be left out. The absence of Brazil in this event would bring very bad consequences for the future performance of the segment in this and other markets”, added Rogério. Rewatch the premiere episode of Stone Summit by clicking here: https://youtu.be/1XadGlEXgXM. This edition was sponsored by Pedrini, Macroex and Sicoob. for all Brazil Open to the participation of all companies in the ornamental stone segment in Brazil, exporters or those with the objective of exporting, It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone aims to increase exports of Brazilian ornamental stones, through a set of strategic actions of internationalization with promotion actions, strengthening the image and development of the sector in the world market. Over the 2021-2023 biennium, the project will be supported by four pillars: · stimulate the development of companies in the sector; · raise awareness of the demand for the diversity of rocks in Brazil; · promote the expansion of markets and the deconcentration of exports; · promote the sector’s image among architects and designers. Preparatory seminars by market, workshops, trade missions, individualized support to participating companies, trade promotion at international fairs, transactional marketing activities, in addition to the Imagem projects (which bring journalists and specialists to Brazil to participate in fairs and/or national events) are foreseen. sectors) and Buyer (which seeks to identify and bring to Brazil distributors, agents and inspectors who have the potential to import and are interested in Brazilian dimension stones). How to be a company supported by the Sectorial Project? To join the It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone project, which will accompany your company in the international market, just follow these two steps: 1. Fill out the pro membership form sectorial form (after completing and signing, send the scanned document via e-mail and send the original via Post Office, to Centrorochas headquarters – Av. Nossa Senhora da Penha, 1.495, Ed. Corporate Center – Sala 1204, Torre A – Santa Lucia – Vitória – ES – 29.056-905). 2. Respond to the targeting survey. This process is essential for the company to comply with the levels established in the partnership signed with Apex-Brasil. And then? After completing the two initial stages, free of charge, the company will begin to be closely monitored by the sectorial project team. The program contemplates a series of actions and they will be indicated in a personalized way. texto: Diversidade, qualidade e sustentabilidade. Esses são alguns dos diferenciais das rochas ornamentais do Brasil que passam a ganhar destaque na nova fase inaugurada pelo segmento nacional. Nesta terça-feira, 06 de julho, o projeto setorial It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone , fruto de uma parceria entre o Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais ( Centrorochas ) e a Agência Brasileira de Promoção de Exportações e Investimentos ( Apex-Brasil ) foi tema do episódio de estreia da segunda temporada do Stone Summit . Transmitido ao vivo pelo Youtube e com telespectadores em todo o país, o evento destacou os objetivos do convênio, os mercados-alvo, a agenda de melhorias propostas, dentre outros assuntos. De um estúdio montado no TVV – Terminal Portuário de Vila Velha, administrado e operado pela Log-In Logística Intermodal, o recém-eleito presidente do Centrorochas, Tales Machado, e o vice-presidente, Fabio Cruz, mediaram o tema ao lado da CEO da Milanez & Milaneze, Flávia Milaneze. Os líderes da entidade setorial nacional reforçaram a importância do momento e do trabalho em conjunto desenvolvido com total apoio dos empresários. “O papel do Centrorochas tem sido bastante desafiador. Este capítulo que começa a ser escrito com o início do projeto setorial foi estabelecido há três anos e intensificado nos últimos 12 meses”, detalhou Fabio. “Há muito o que ser feito, mas contamos com o primordial que é o alinhamento com os empresários e com as entidades setoriais pelo bem comum de todo segmento nacional”, completou Tales. O debate sobre as ações do projeto setorial foi enriquecido com participação remota dos empresários e membros do comitê gestor do convênio firmado entre Centrorochas e Apex-Brasil: David Silveira (Granos), Gustavo Probst (Decolores) e Renan Catelan (Cattegran). Com diferentes perfis de atuação, eles contribuíram com argumentos práticos de quem tem vivência tanto no mercado externo como interno. Os dois primeiros, foram pontuais com relação à presença do setor no mercado internacional reforçando a importância da definição dos países-alvo estabelecidos pelo projeto. Já Renan pontuou e representou a parcela de empresas que ainda não exportam e podem também ser apoiadas pelo convênio setorial. “Ainda não exporto, mas estou muito feliz com toda esta união pelo bem do setor. É bom fazer parte desse projeto e poder ser acompanhado neste novo desafio, que é exportar, desde o início do processo”, afirmou. O diretor da Revista Rochas de Qualidade, Felipe Vampré, e o gerente do projeto setorial, Rogério Ribeiro, também participaram de forma remota e apontaram ações primordiais do It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone. “Temos que munir os especificadores internacionais com informações técnicas. Uma ação muito importante é educar os distribuidores, marmoristas e arquitetos para eles saberem o tipo de produto que estão lidando”, enfatizou Felipe. “Esta semana, de 7 a 9 de julho, acontece nossa primeira ação, na Coverings 2021. Tivemos pouco tempo entre a assinatura do convênio e o início da feira, mas não poderíamos ficar de fora. A ausência do Brasil neste evento traria reflexos muito ruins para o desempenho futuro do segmento nesse e em outros mercados”, complementou Rogério. Reveja o episódio de estreia do Stone Summit clicando aqui: https://youtu.be/1XadGlEXgXM . Esta edição contou com patrocínio da Pedrini, Macroex e Sicoob. Para todo o Brasil Aberto à participação de todas as empresas do segmento de rochas ornamentais do Brasil, exportadoras ou que tenham o objetivo de exportar, o It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone tem por objetivo aumentar as exportações de rochas ornamentais brasileiras, através de um conjunto de ações estratégicas de internacionalização com ações de promoção, fortalecimento da imagem e desenvolvimento do setor no mercado mundial. texto: The It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone project, the result of a partnership between the Brazilian Center for Ornamental Stones Exporters (Centrorochas) and the Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency (Apex-Brasil), will be present at this year’s Coverings edition with a stand that stands out for being a space for meeting and coexistence between companies. The premier trade show for the natural stone industry in North America will take place July 7-9 in the North Hall of the Orange County Convention Center in Orlando, Florida. During the three days of the event, 24 companies supported by It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone will have their brands and institutional materials disseminated through visual resources displayed in the stand of about 140 m², installed in a strategic location (Tile Council of North America, booth 3836). In the special configuration defined for this action, companies will still have the opportunity to use the space as a meeting point and network. The environment matrix was defined after thorough analyzes that took into account several factors, including the global pandemic situation, which made it impossible to hold the 2020 edition of the fair and the current restrictions imposed on entry into the United States. According to Fabio Cruz, vice-president of Centrorochas, “this action aims to consolidate Brazilian participation in the North American market, which has a high potential for purchases and influence in neighboring markets”. Companies will have hybrid support during the event. The Vice President of Centrorochas and the project manager, Rogério Ribeiro, will interact via videoconference and Felipe Ruback will be the representative of the sectoral agreement on site. About It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone is an export incentive program developed by the Brazilian Center for Ornamental Stones Exporters (Centrorochas) in partnership with the Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency (APEX-Brasil). This program aims to increase exports of Brazilian ornamental stones, through a set of strategic internationalization actions with promotion actions, strengthening the image and development of the sector in the world market. About Centrorochas The Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Pedras Ornamentais acts directly in the procedures related to the presence of Brazilian businessmen abroad combined with commercial and operational activities related to the development and evolution of Brazilian companies. About Apex-Brasil Apex-Brasil acts to promote Brazilian products and services abroad and attract foreign investment to strategic sectors of the Brazilian economy. To achieve these goals, the Agency carries out diversified trade promotion actions aimed at promoting exports and valuing Brazilian products and services abroad, such as prospective and trade missions, business roundtables, support for the participation of Brazilian companies in major international fairs, visits of foreign buyers and opinion makers to get to know the Brazilian production structure, among other business platforms that also aim to strengthen the Brazil brand.

texto: At an Extraordinary General Meeting (AGE) held this Monday, June 28, Tales Machado, from Magban, and current president of Sindirochas, was elected president of the Brazilian Center for Ornamental Stones Exporters (Centrorochas). Fabio Cruz, current vice-president, was re-elected to the post. At the opening of the election, the current president, Frederico Robison, thanked all entrepreneurs for their trust and partnership during the three years in which he was at the head of the entity and made a brief assessment of the period. “One of our purposes was to align ourselves with other entities to strengthen the sector, and I believe we succeeded. Today, entities, boards, presidents and councils act in a convergent manner with the sole purpose of strengthening the sector. Of course, we cannot please everyone or share the same idea, but I believe this is healthy and part of any evolutionary process”, he pointed out. In his first speech as president-elect, Tales Machado, who will end his term at the head of Sindirochas in August this year, reinforced that he hopes to continue with the support of all members and exporters to continue the work carried out so far. “We have been working to end the differences that existed in the sector, we have made achievements, but we still have a lot to deliver. I hope to count on the help of all exporters. We sought to form a list that represented all fronts and it has experienced businessmen who are fully aligned with this purpose. From now on, I would like to thank each one of them for their availability so that, together, we can tread a path of conquests for the entire segment of national dimension stones”, he said. Re-elected as vice-president, Fabio Cruz reinforced the approximation work done with other entities and asked for a more direct participation of all exporters. “There has always been a maxim in the industry that there was disunity. Today, this maxim does not apply as much. We have an open dialogue with companies, proximity and alignment with employers in Espírito Santo, Minas Gerais and Ceará, the three largest exporting states in the country, among others. So far, we have taken a path to remove obstacles, now we have fertile ground to plant and, effectively, in a few years, we will be able to reap the fruits of these actions. I would like to take this opportunity to appeal to all entrepreneurs to act directly in the actions that are being and will be worked on by Centrorochas. We are going to create working groups for specific subjects and the expertise of each one will be very welcome”, he stressed. The inauguration ceremony of the new board will be scheduled for an upcoming date and communicated shortly. texto: Em Assembleia Geral Extraordinária (AGE) realizada nesta segunda-feira, 28 de junho, Tales Machado, da Magban, e atual presidente do Sindirochas, foi eleito presidente do Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais (Centrorochas). Fabio Cruz, atual vice-presidente, foi reeleito para o cargo. Na abertura do pleito, o atual presidente, Frederico Robison, agradeceu a todos empresários pela confiança e parceria durante os três anos em que ficou à frente da entidade e fez um breve balanço do período. “Um de nossos propósitos era o alinhamento com outras entidades pelo fortalecimento do setor e acredito que conseguimos. Hoje, as entidades, diretorias, presidentes e conselhos atuam de forma convergente com o único propósito de fortalecer o setor. Claro que não conseguimos agradar a todos e nem compartilhar da mesma ideia, mas acredito que isso seja sadio e faça parte de qualquer processo evolutivo”, pontuou. Em seu primeiro pronunciamento como presidente eleito, Tales Machado, que encerrará seu mandato à frente do Sindirochas em agosto deste ano, reforçou que espera continuar com o apoio de todos os associados e exportadores para dar continuidade ao trabalho executado até aqui. “Temos atuado para acabar com as diferenças que existiam no setor, tivemos conquistas, mas ainda temos muito a entregar. Espero contar com a ajuda de todos os exportadores. Buscamos formar uma chapa que representasse todas as frentes e ela conta com empresários experientes que estão totalmente alinhados com esse propósito. Desde já, agradeço a disponibilidade de cada um deles para que, juntos, possamos trilhar um caminho de conquistas para todo o segmento de rochas ornamentais nacional”, afirmou. Reeleito como vice-presidente, Fabio Cruz reforçou o trabalho de aproximação feito com outras entidades e pediu a participação mais direta a todos os exportadores. “Sempre houve uma máxima no setor de que havia desunião. Hoje, essa máxima não se aplica tanto. Temos diálogo aberto com as empresas, proximidade e alinhamento com as entidades patronais do Espírito Santo, Minas Gerais e Ceará, os três maiores estados exportadores do país, dentre outros. Até aqui, trilhamos um caminho para retirar os obstáculos, agora temos um terreno fértil para plantar e, efetivamente, daqui a alguns anos, podermos colher os frutos destas ações. Aproveito para fazer um apelo a todos os empresários para atuarem diretamente nas ações que estão sendo e serão trabalhadas pelo Centrorochas. Vamos criar grupos de trabalho para assuntos específicos e a expertise de cada um será super bem-vinda.”, frisou. A cerimônia de posse da nova diretorial será marcada para data próxima e comunicada em breve. texto: The vice-president of the Brazilian Center for Dimension Stone Exporters (Centrorochas), Fabio Cruz, and the manager of It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone, Rogério Ribeiro, conducted this Thursday, June 24, the first event held by the entity as executor of the ornamental stone sectoral agreement, signed in partnership with the Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency (Apex-Brasil). The focus of the meeting was the Brazilian participation in Coverings 2021, which will take place from July 7th to 9th, in Orlando, Florida. Brazil will be present with a stand that will be the home of companies at the event, where they will be able to receive their clients, hold meetings and use it as support during the three days. Still as a space for meeting and coexistence, the stand will allow interaction between visitors and the creation of a network in a structure with about 140 m² in a strategic location. Visual resources installed in the stand will allow companies to activate their brands and products. The presentations will be distributed in three totems with LCD screens that will display logos and other commercial materials provided by the companies served by the sectoral agreement. “Considering the short time for preparation, the global pandemic situation, which imposes restrictions on entry into the United States, and the influence of this factor on the visitation capacity and, consequently, on the results of the fair, we opted for an alternative participation in order to make gifts, promote Brazilian rocks, companies and, of course, encourage interaction and future business”, pointed out Fabio. “The absence of Brazil in this event, which is so strategically important for the dimension stone sector, would have very bad effects on the segment’s future performance in this and other markets”, reinforced the project manager, Rogério Ribeiro. Exceptionally in this action, it will not be possible to send samples by companies. Considering the scenario of the global pandemic situation, which influences the capacity to visit the fair and, consequently, the results of the event, Centrorochas opted for a suggested contribution of 500 dollars. Non-payment, however, does not prevent the company from participating. Despite having different and mandatory values in the adherence to each action of the sectoral project, the value will be used as support for the sector. The entity thoroughly analyzed all the health restrictions imposed and decided that, for the said fair, the recommended charge would be the best alternative. It is important to emphasize that all work is carried out with total transparency and its main objective is to enhance the ornamental stone sector in the international market. texto: O vice-presidente do Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais ( Centrorochas ), Fabio Cruz, e o gestor do It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone , Rogério Ribeiro, conduziram nesta quinta-feira, 24 de junho, o primeiro evento realizado pela entidade como executora do convênio setorial de rochas ornamentais, firmado em parceria com a Agência Brasileira de Promoção de Exportações e Investimentos ( Apex-Brasil ). O foco do encontro foi a participação brasileira na Coverings 2021 , que acontecerá de 07 a 09 de julho, em Orlando, na Flórida. O Brasil estará presente com um estande que será a casa das empresas no evento, onde poderão receber seus clientes, fazer reuniões e utilizar como apoio durante os três dias. Ainda como um espaço de encontro e convivência, o estande permitirá a interação entre os visitantes e a criação de network em uma estrutura com cerca de 140 m² em localização estratégica. Recursos visuais instalados no estande permitirão a ativação, pelas empresas, de suas marcas e produtos. As apresentações serão distribuídas em três totens com telas de LCD que irão exibir logomarcas e outros materiais comerciais fornecidos pelas empresas atendidas pelo convênio setorial. “Considerando o pouco prazo para preparação, a situação pandêmica mundial, que impõe restrições para a entrada nos Estados Unidos, e a influência desse fator na capacidade de visitação e, consequentemente nos resultados da feira, optamos por uma participação alternativa com o objetivo de nos fazer presentes, promover as rochas brasileiras, as empresas e, claro, estimular a interação e realização de negócios futuros”, apontou Fabio. “A ausência do Brasil neste evento, que é tão importante estrategicamente para o setor de rochas ornamentais, traria reflexos muito ruins para o desempenho futuro do segmento nesse e em outros mercados”, reforçou o gestor do projeto, Rogério Ribeiro. Excepcionalmente nesta ação, não será possível o envio de amostras pelas empresas. Considerando o cenário da situação pandêmica mundial, que influencia na capacidade de visitação da feira e, consequentemente nos resultados do evento, o Centrorochas optou por uma contribuição sugerida de 500 dólares. O não pagamento, no entanto, não impede a participação da empresa. Apesar de ter valores diferentes e obrigatórios na adesão de cada ação do projeto setorial, o valor entrará como apoio ao setor. A entidade analisou a fundo todas as restrições sanitárias impostas e decidiu que, para a referida feira, a cobrança recomendada seria a melhor alternativa. É importante frisar que todo trabalho é executado com total transparência e tem como objetivo principal a valorização do setor de rochas ornamentais no mercado internacional. Como participar Coverings 2021 1º – Fazer adesão ao projeto setorial It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone 2º – Preencher o formulário de segmentação 3º – Enviar, até 30/06/21 material institucional para karina.portofirme@centrorochas.org.br : – vídeo institucional da empresa; – imagens de boa qualidade da produção e de materiais; – logotipo da empresa em alta resolução. 4º – Cobrança da contribuição sugerida (taxa de 500 dólares) até o dia 09/07/21. Canais para dúvidas: Fabio Cruz (vice-presidente do Centrorochas) – 27 99238-0127 Rogério Ribeiro (gestor do projeto) – 28 99884-3033 Alessandra Bertolani (gestora de relacionamento) – 27 99983-5125 Sobre o Centrorochas O Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais atua diretamente nos trâmites relacionados à presença do empresário brasileiro no exterior combinado com atividades comerciais e operacionais relativas ao desenvolvimento e evolução das empresas brasileiras. Sobre a Apex-Brasil A Apex-Brasil atua para promover os produtos e serviços brasileiros no exterior e atrair investimentos estrangeiros para setores estratégicos da economia brasileira. Para alcançar esses objetivos, a Agência realiza ações diversificadas de promoção comercial que visam promover as exportações e valorizar os produtos e serviços brasileiros no exterior, como missões prospectivas e comerciais, rodadas de negócios, apoio à participação de empresas brasileiras em grandes feiras internacionais, visitas de compradores estrangeiros e formadores de opinião para conhecer a estrutura produtiva brasileira entre outras plataformas de negócios que também têm por objetivo fortalecer a marca Brasil.

texto: The Brazilian ornamental stone sector will be represented at this year’s edition of Coverings, one of the main fairs in the sector, which takes place from July 7th to 9th, in Orlando/USA. Participation will take place through It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone, a program to promote exports of Brazilian ornamental stones, a partnership between the Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency (Apex-Brasil) and the Brazilian Center for Ornamental Stones Exporters (Centrorochas ). Representing the Brazilian sector at the fair is the first major action under the cooperation agreement signed on May 31, just 37 days before the start of the North American fair. Thus, considering the short period of time for preparation, the global pandemic situation, which imposes restrictions on entry into the United States, and the influence of this factor on the visitation capacity and, consequently, on the results of the fair, we opted for an alternative participation, different from that was being done by the sector. Brazil will be present with a stand that will be the home of companies at the event. The measure is a sign of respect and attention to companies in the sector, preserving their investments and maintaining the brand’s exposure in the international market, as well as the good relationship with the event’s promoter. The It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone stand will be open to receive businessmen who, given the circumstances, will visit the fair to serve customers, suppliers and partners. Participating companies, in addition to being able to use the stand as a meeting point and support, will be visually noticed in the space by displaying images that they make available, such as logos and institutional videos. The company’s participation, even if through images, is conditioned to the signature of the Term of Adhesion and completion of the segmentation form (https://pt.surveymonkey.com/r/HYBYFR7) of the Agreement. The adhesion term can be digitally signed, provided the electronic signature is in accordance with ICP-Brasil (usually linked to the requirement of a token). If the document is signed manually, the original document must be sent to Centrorochas. To clarify any doubts and open a space for dialogue with companies in the sector, we will promote a virtual meeting this Thursday, 06/24, at 7 pm. Confirm your presence through the link: https://bit.ly/3gJL4om —– SERVICE: Coverings Stone Fair 2021 Date: from 7 to 9 July 2021 Location: North Hall of the Orange County Convention Center in Orlando, Florida. Institutional participation in the program It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone.

texto: Apex-Brasil and Centrorochas launched a partnership this Wednesday (16th), in Brasília. The idea is to leverage the internationalization of the sector, which already contributes with an annual average of US$ 1 billion exported. The Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency (Apex-Brasil) launched today (6/16) the project for the internationalization of the ornamental stone sector, carried out through a partnership with the Brazilian Center for Ornamental Stone Exporters (Centrorochas), in ceremony at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MRE), in Brasília. The objective of the partnership is to expand exports of Brazilian dimension stones, in addition to stimulating the sale of products with high added value. With an annual average of US$ 1 billion in exports, Brazil occupies the fifth position in the world in the production of ornamental stones. The idea is to leverage the numbers, based on the new agreement and the expertise in internationalization of Apex-Brasil. At the signing ceremony, the president of Apex-Brasil, Augusto Pestana, stated that the sectoral project will be essential to increase sector exports. “It is with great satisfaction that, at the house of Rio Branco, we came to reiterate Apex-Brasil’s commitment to the entire ornamental stone sector. For the coming years, significant growth is expected in this segment, with new opportunities and open frontiers for national companies, including smaller ones, which will count on the support of Apex-Brasil to transform these opportunities into concrete business. The project includes digital actions, fundamental in the context of the pandemic, and also strengthens initiatives to add value to the products of the sector”, he said. The Minister of Foreign Affairs, Carlos Alberto França, reinforced that the mining sector accounts for around 2.5% of GDP and more than R$ 50 billion in taxes and royalties a year. “It is a dynamic and innovative sector that develops in a sustainable way, based on a modern regulatory framework that induces new investments. Our great challenge in the mineral sector is to diversify our exports, which are still concentrated in iron ore. The non-metallic subsector, which is where ornamental stones are inserted, is the one that generates the most jobs: there are more than 12 thousand companies, most of them medium and small, and almost half a million direct and indirect jobs. Brazil already occupies a prominent position in the world, but there is potential for us to further leverage our global participation in this segment, leading to additional positive results in the generation of income and jobs”, he said. Also present at the signing ceremony, the Minister of Mines and Energy, Bento Albuquerque, said that the MME Mining and Development Program, prepared by the Ministry and launched in 2020 by President Jair Bolsonaro, provides for several development objectives for the sector, which will be worked on by the sectoral project, such as adding value to products and opening new markets. “As much as Brazil is the fifth largest producer and exporter of ornamental stones, having exported 2.16 million tons in 2020, we need to diversify our buyers, currently very concentrated in the United States and China. I am convinced that the partnership signed today will greatly contribute to the social and regional development of the country, since the sector has as its characteristic component a wide network of small and medium-sized companies, generating jobs and income in various locations in the country. It will also serve to disseminate the diversity and attractiveness of national rocks in the world, from the most traditional to the most exotic”. The importance of the sector for the Brazilian economy and the relevance of the new project was reinforced by the president of Centrorochas, Frederico Robison, who highlighted that the sector is new, only 60 years old, but has developed a lot. “Today we begin a new phase for promoting the natural beauties of Brazilian rocks in the international market. Throughout the project, we will work to increase the volume of exports, add value to the products, increase the number of exporting companies and work together with foreign designers and architects. Despite the high degree of maturity of some companies in the sector in the foreign market, this is not a reality for all those companies that export or that wish to export. This project will allow the adoption of structuring measures, of sectoral organization, which are extremely relevant for the evolution of the sector, creating a more favorable environment for the development of companies and their activities”, he highlighted. Federal deputy Evair Vieira de Melo (PP-ES), deputy leader of the government, attended the event and said he was motivated by the signed agreement. “This gesture by Apex-Brasil is a stimulus for the ornamental stone sector to continue representing Brazil with greatness and brings answers and solutions to a sector that needs it. It will become GDP in the trade balance, it will become a platform of pride for Brazilians,” he said. The ceremony was also attended by the vice-president of Centrorochas, Fabio Cruz, in addition to representatives of exporting companies in Brazil. about the sector According to Centrorochas, Brazilian exports of ornamental stones showed, in the first four months of this year, a growth of 28.5% in revenue compared to the same period in 2020. In total, the national sector exported 655.5 thousand tons of rocks, including slabs and blocks – the main importing countries were the United States (42.6%), China (27.4%) and Italy (6.4%). Espírito Santo stands out in the stone sector as it is the largest producer and the main exporter of slabs and blocks in Brazil, with the largest processing park and the largest production center of capital goods for the segment. In 2019, the State accounted for 81.7% of total revenue and 76.2% of the total physical volume of Brazilian stone exports. Added to Ceará

texto: Apex-Brasil e Centrorochas lançaram parceria nesta quarta-feira (16), em Brasília. A ideia é alavancar internacionalização do setor, que já contribui com a média anual de US$ 1 bilhão exportados. A Agência Brasileira de Promoção de Exportações e Investimentos ( Apex-Brasil ) lançou hoje (16/6) o projeto de internacionalização do setor de rochas ornamentais, realizado por meio de parceria com o Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais ( Centrorochas ), em cerimônia no Ministério das Relações Exteriores (MRE), em Brasília. O objetivo da parceria é ampliar as exportações das rochas ornamentais brasileiras, além de estimular a comercialização de produtos com alto valor agregado. Com uma média anual de US$ 1 bilhão em exportações, o Brasil ocupa a quinta posição mundial na produção de rochas ornamentais. A ideia é alavancar os números, a partir do novo convênio e da expertise em internacionalização da Apex-Brasil. Na cerimônia de assinatura, o presidente da Apex-Brasil, Augusto Pestana, afirmou que o projeto setorial será fundamental para aumentar as exportações do setor. “É com grande satisfação que, na casa de Rio Branco, viemos reiterar o compromisso da Apex-Brasil com todo o setor de rochas ornamentais. Para os próximos anos, espera-se um crescimento expressivo deste segmento, com novas oportunidades e fronteiras abertas para as empresas nacionais, inclusive as de menor porte, que contarão com o apoio da Apex-Brasil para transformação dessas oportunidades em negócios concretos. O projeto contempla ações digitais, fundamentais no contexto da pandemia e, ainda, fortalece iniciativas para agregação de valor aos produtos do setor”, afirmou. O ministro das Relações Exteriores, Carlos Alberto França, reforçou que o setor de mineração responde por cerca de 2,5% do PIB e mais de R$ 50 bilhões em tributos e royalties ao ano. “É um setor dinâmico e inovador que se desenvolve de forma sustentável, a partir de um quadro regulatório moderno e indutor de novos investimentos. Nosso grande desafio no setor mineral é diversificar nossas exportações, que ainda são concentradas em minério de ferro. O subsetor de não-metálicos, que é onde se inserem as rochas ornamentais, é o que gera mais empregos: são mais de 12 mil empresas, a maior parte de médio e pequeno porte, e quase meio milhão de empregos diretos e indiretos. O Brasil já ocupa posição de destaque no mundo, mas há potencial para alavancarmos ainda mais nossa participação global nesse segmento, acarretando resultados positivos adicionais na geração de renda e empregos”, afirmou. Também presente na cerimônia de assinatura, o ministro de Minas e Energia, Bento Albuquerque, afirmou que o Programa Mineração e Desenvolvimento do MME, elaborado pelo Ministério e lançado em 2020 pelo presidente Jair Bolsonaro, prevê diversos objetivos de desenvolvimento do setor, que serão trabalhados pelo projeto setorial, como a agregação de valor aos produtos e a abertura de novos mercados. “Por mais que o Brasil seja o quinto maior produtor e exportador de rochas ornamentais, tendo exportado em 2020, 2,16 milhões de toneladas, precisamos diversificar os nossos compradores, atualmente muito concentrados nos Estados Unidos e na China. Estou convicto de que a parceria firmada hoje contribuirá sobremaneira para o desenvolvimento social e regional do país, uma vez que setor traz como componente característico uma ampla rede de pequenas e médias empresas, gerando emprego e renda em várias localidades do país. Servirá ainda para disseminar a diversidade atratividade das rochas nacionais no mundo, das mais tradicionais às mais exóticas”. A importância do setor para a economia brasileira e a relevância do novo projeto foi reforçada pelo presidente do Centrorochas, Frederico Robison, que destacou que o setor é novo, com apenas 60 anos, mas tem se desenvolvido muito. “Hoje começamos uma nova fase para promoção das belezas naturais das rochas brasileiras no mercado internacional. Ao longo do projeto, trabalharemos para aumentar o volume das exportações, agregar valor aos produtos, aumentar o número de empresas exportadoras e desenvolver um trabalho junto a designers e arquitetos estrangeiros. Apesar do alto grau de maturidade de algumas empresas do setor no mercado externo, esta não é uma realidade para todas aquelas empresas que exportam ou que desejam exportar. Este projeto permitirá a adoção de medidas estruturantes, de organização setorial, que são de extrema relevância para a evolução do setor, criando um ambiente mais propício para o desenvolvimento das empresas e suas atividades”, destacou. O deputado federal Evair Vieira de Melo (PP-ES), vice-líder do governo, prestigiou o evento e disse estar motivado com o convênio firmado. “Esse gesto da Apex-Brasil é um estímulo para que o setor de rochas ornamentais continue representando com grandeza o Brasil e traz respostas e soluções para um setor que precisa. Vai virar PIB na balança comercial, vai virar uma plataforma de orgulho para os brasileiros”, afirmou. A cerimônia ainda contou com a presença do vice-presidente do Centrorochas, Fabio Cruz, além de representantes de empresas exportadoras do Brasil. Sobre o setor De acordo com o Centrorochas, as exportações brasileiras de rochas ornamentais apresentaram, no primeiro quadrimestre deste ano, um crescimento de 28,5% no faturamento em relação ao mesmo período de 2020. No total, o setor nacional exportou 655,5 mil toneladas de rochas, entre chapas e blocos – os principais países importadores foram Estados Unidos (42,6%), China (27,4%) e Itália (6,4%). O Espírito Santo possui destaque no setor de rochas por ser o maior produtor e o principal exportador de chapas e blocos do Brasil, detendo o maior parque de beneficiamento e o maior polo produtor de bens de capital para o segmento. texto: The president of the Brazilian Center for Ornamental Stone Exporters (Centrorochas), Frederico Robison, accompanied by the vice-president of the entity, Fabio Cruz, and the advisor, Tales Machado, participated on Friday, May 28, in a meeting with the president from the Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency (Apex-Brasil), Augusto Pestana. The virtual meeting aimed to strengthen the relationship between the entities, as President Pestana had recently taken office. Innovation, business intelligence, quality foreign investment, promotion of Brazil’s image abroad and greater integration with the Itamaraty network: “these are the five guidelines that I present as a work plan for this challenging moment, but full of opportunities”, said Pestana during the inauguration held on May 12th. At today’s meeting, the president of Apex-Brasil also reinforced the importance of the ornamental stone sector for the Brazilian economy and exports, as well as the Agency’s interest in continuing to support companies in the segment. Also participating in the meeting were the executive director of Centrorochas, Celmo de Freitas; the manager of Industry and Services at Apex-Brasil, Maria Paula Velloso; and the manager of Apex-Brasil’s Presidency Office, Igor Brandão.

texto: This Wednesday, May 19, the Minister of Mines and Energy, Bento Albuquerque, took a closer look at the sector of ornamental stones in the state of Espírito Santo, the largest producer and exporter of stones in Brazil. During the trip, made at the invitation of federal deputy Evair Vieira de Melo (PP-ES), he announced the forecast that an agreement will be signed, in the order of R$ 30 million, to stimulate Brazilian exports in the segment on the international market. The president of Centrorochas, Frederico Robison, accompanied the entire agenda, which included visits to companies in the municipalities of Castelo and Cachoeiro de Itapemirim. “Apex-Brasil is finalizing a project to encourage, to increase, exports from the ornamental stone sector, not only diversifying, but also adding value to the products that leave Espírito Santo. I think this is very important, it shows that the sector is recognized, valued and has a great capacity to generate jobs, income and wealth for the country”, said Bento Albuquerque. During the visit, the Minister got to know CS3 Revestimentos, a company that has a significant presence in the ornamental stone market in Brazil and in 27 countries. He also got to know Bramagran, an ornamental stone company with more than 30 years in the market, and MG2, which is expanding its industrial park to serve the domestic and foreign markets. In addition, he visited Itaoca Pedra, in Cachoeiro de Itapemirim, where the processes for extracting materials were presented. He also visited Mineração Capixaba, a pioneer in marble extraction in the southern region of the state. Magban also received a visit from the Minister and his entourage, where improvement processes for the main materials worked on were presented. Businessmen from the sector highlighted the importance of the Minister’s visit, a cause for satisfaction, given that this gesture demonstrates the Federal Government’s recognition of the strength and importance of the sector, noting that this is the first time that a Minister of Mines and Energy has visited companies in the sector of ornamental stones. Brazilian exports of ornamental stones showed, in the first quarter of this year, a growth of 28.5% in revenue compared to the same period of 2020. Exports from Espírito Santo also grew by approximately 28%. The data were released this week by Centrorochas and Sindirochas, entities representing the sector. Photo credit: Bruno Spada/MME; Wallace Hull; Fabiano Oliveira; Karina Porto Firme

texto: O Ministro de Minas e Energia , Bento Albuquerque, conheceu de perto nesta quarta-feira, 19 de maio, o setor de rochas ornamentais do estado do Espírito Santo, maior produtor e exportador de rochas do Brasil. Espírito Santo, the largest producer and exporter of ornamental stones in Brazil, is responsible for 82% of national exports. From January to April this year, the main exporting municipalities were Serra (24.5%), Cachoeiro de Itapemirim (21.2%) and Barra de São Francisco (11.9%). In the first four months of the year, the national sector shipped around 655,500 tons of slabs and blocks. United States (42.6%), China (27.4%) and Italy (6.4%) received the largest amount of Brazilian products. In the first quarter of last year, the segment recorded a drop as a result of the Covid-19 pandemic. Since then, companies have reinvented processes and, overcoming adversities, began to see the new scenario as an opportunity. According to the report released by the entities, Centrorochas and Sindirochas, the increase in Brazilian exports this year could have been even more positive, were it not for the problems that have been faced by the segment so that they can carry out their exports. Among the main obstacles faced by the sector are ship delays, omission (cancellation) of ship trips, gate restrictions for receiving loaded containers destined for export, in addition to the additional costs they bring to exporters, it does not allow the movement of goods to occur in the time they should. texto: Centrorochas, Sindirochas, Sindiex, Vitória Coffee Trade Center, FINDES, Login and APRA, entities that make up the Foreign Trade Working Group (GT Comex), met on Tuesday, May 11, when, among other topics , there was an update by Login-TVV on the completed and ongoing measures that will help to circumvent the logistical obstacles presented recently. Progress highlighted at the meeting: 1. 30 new employees have already been hired and trained, having started their activities on 05/10; 2. Work by Álvares Cabral that TVV took over will be completed on 05/12. With this, it is expected that the Port Authority will release the night operation of the port, which will save time in operations; 3. As of June, the Login Resiliente ship will make the Vitória x Rio de Janeiro connection, with the Pantanal Login remaining on the Vitória x Santos connection; 4. In up to 15 days, another 400 slots must be released at TVV, as a result of the cargo handling they are doing; 5. Next Sunday, 05/16, the ship Login Jatobá will carry out an extra-scheduled trip, reiterating that these extra operations will be maintained while the high demand lasts. GT Comex aims to discuss the difficulties faced in the export and import processes in Espírito Santo, seeking short and medium term alternatives, in addition to seeking more definitive solutions for logistics infrastructure. Among those who participated in the meeting were: Tales Machado (Sindirochas and Findes), Celmo de Freitas (Centrorochas and Sindirochas), Sidemar Acosta, Felipe Bonella and Minelli Ferraro (Sindiex), Ilson Hulle (Login-TVV), Márcio Ferreira and Sandro Rodrigues ( CCCV), Luciana Mattar (APRA).

texto: With the second wave of the Covid-19 pandemic, the stoppage of various activities and the high unemployment rate, several people have been facing a daily struggle: to satisfy hunger. Of the side effects of the health crisis, this is the most serious, because food is essential for survival. Aware of this need, Rochativa, an association of social activities in the ornamental stone sector of Espírito Santo, started a campaign to collect basic food baskets. The movement “Against hunger, together we are stronger” has the support of Centrorochas (Brazilian Center for Dimension Stone Exporters), Sindirochas (Union of Dimension Stone, Lime and Limestone Industries of the State of Espírito Santo) and Cetemag (Technological Center Marble and Granite). The initial objective is to collect 2,000 basic food baskets to serve families in vulnerable situations, mapped in the three industrial centers of the stone sector in Espírito Santo: south, center and northwest. According to the president of Rochativa, Valdecyr Viguini, the campaign plans to reach everyone, with distribution proportional to each region. “The situation is very serious. We count on the support of all capixabas, businessmen and individuals, so that we can reach the goal as quickly as possible. Those who are hungry cannot wait!”, he warns. “Rochativa is taking this action to serve needy people and for those who did not have the same opportunity, in this moment of pandemic, to continue working as we do”, reinforces the president of Centrorochas, Frederico Robison. “We want to involve the entire stone sector so that we can run a beautiful campaign and help those in need”, adds the president of Sindirochas, Tales Machado. Together, Rochativa, Sindirochas, Cetemag and Centrorochas have been collecting and donating food baskets since last year. In 2020, the campaign received 3,000 basic food baskets that served around 500 families in eight municipalities in Espírito Santo. how to donate Visit the campaign website www.contrafome.com.br to make your donation. All amount raised will be reversed in the purchase of basic baskets.

texto: Com a segunda onda da pandemia do Covid-19, a paralisação de várias atividades e o alto índice de desemprego, várias pessoas têm enfrentado diariamente uma luta: saciar a fome. Dos efeitos colaterais da crise sanitária, esse é o mais grave, porque alimento é o básico para a sobrevivência. Atenta a esta necessidade, a Rochativa , associação de atividades sociais do setor de rochas ornamentais do Espírito Santo, iniciou uma campanha para arrecadação de cestas básicas. O movimento “Contra a fome, juntos somos mais fortes” conta com apoio do Centrorochas (Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais), Sindirochas (Sindicato das Indústrias de Rochas Ornamentais, Cal e Calcários do Estado do Espírito Santo) e Cetemag (Centro Tecnológico do Mármore e Granito). O objetivo inicial é arrecadar 2 mil cestas básicas para atender famílias em situação de vulnerabilidade, mapeadas nos três polos industriais do setor de rochas no Espírito Santo: sul, centro e noroeste. Segundo o presidente da Rochativa, Valdecyr Viguini, a campanha prevê atingir a todos, com distribuição proporcional a cada região. “A situação é muito séria. Nós contamos com o apoio de todos os capixabas, empresários e pessoas físicas, para que possamos alcançar a meta o mais rápido possível. Quem tem fome não pode esperar!”, alerta. “A Rochativa está com esta ação para atender pessoas carentes e para aquelas que não tiveram a mesma oportunidade, nesse momento de pandemia, de continuar trabalhando como a gente”, reforça o presidente do Centrorochas, Frederico Robison. “Queremos envolver todo o setor de rochas para que a gente faça uma campanha bonita e ajude a quem necessita”, completa o presidente do Sindirochas, Tales Machado. Juntos, Rochativa, Sindirochas, Cetemag e Centrorochas têm arrecadado e realizado doações de cestas básicas desde o ano passado. Em 2020 a campanha recebeu 3 mil cestas básicas que atenderam cerca de 500 famílias, em oito municípios capixabas. Como doar Acesse o site da campanha www.contrafome.com.br para fazer sua doação. Todo valor arrecadado será revertido na compra de cestas básicas.

texto: The webinar “Scenarios and perspectives in port operations”, held by Centrorochas and Sindirochas, this Thursday, April 22, had a massive participation of ornamental stone exporters from Espírito Santo, bringing together about 160 participants. Focused on guiding companies in the segment about the logistical challenges they are currently facing, the event brought together representatives from Login-TVV and MSC to clarify the efforts being made in the search for normalcy or to minimize problems, in addition to pointing out expectations for the future. At the opening, the vice-president of Centrorochas, Fabio Cruz, highlighted the importance of the meeting. “This approach to debate and try to put everyone on the same page is very important for everyone involved in the stone export chain”, he pointed out. The president of Sindirochas, Tales Machado, thanked Login-TVV and MSC for their willingness to dialogue throughout the process and their attention to the actions being developed. “As entities, we will always act in the search for solutions, as well as in the defense of the interests of our associates”, he said. MSC commercial director, Laurent Vandervoo, participated in the event alongside line and capacity director, João Neto, and commercial manager, Samanta Lazarini. “The stone sector is of enormous importance to our business. Occasionally, we had some issues that led to bottlenecks in shipments, but MSC is extremely involved and working hard, together with TVV and other actors, to try to get back to normal as soon as possible,” said Vandervoo. As one of the planned actions to minimize operational impacts, the shipowner decided to change the BTP service from Santos to Rio de Janeiro, as first announced by director João Neto. “We will still make the formal communication, but I can already say that, starting in June, we will make this change and this will save time in operations, due to the shorter distance from Vitória to Rio, and avoid cargo congestion, as the port the new destination has less traffic than Santos”, he explained. In his presentation, Login-TVV’s director of terminals, Ilson Hulle, highlighted the actions outlined to generate operating capacity in the system in the short, medium and long term. “Right now, we are going through some unplanned circumstances, but we have planned actions and others already implemented”, he pointed out. Among them is authorization for night maneuvers, for ships of up to 220 meters, which should take place by May. With this release, there will be an average gain of 7 hours per stopover. In addition, the Codesa privatization process must go through the auction to choose the management model, in November. “We have closely monitored all procedures and we believe that opportunities may arise such as increased storage capacity, new container berths and a total draft of 12.5m”, he detailed. Login-TVV’s commercial manager, Pedro Benevides, also participated in the webinar which was mediated by the executive director of Centrorochas e Sindirochas, Celmo de Freitas.

Focado na orientação das empresas do segmento sobre os desafios logísticos que estão sendo enfrentados no momento, o evento reuniu representantes da Login-TVV e da MSC para esclarecerem sobre os esforços que estão sendo realizados em busca da normalidade ou minimização dos problemas, além de apontar expectativas para o futuro. Na abertura, o vice-presidente do Centrorochas, Fabio Cruz, destacou a importância do encontro. “Essa aproximação para debater e tentar colocar todo mundo na mesma página é muito importante para todos os envolvidos na cadeia exportadora de rochas”, pontuou. O presidente do Sindirochas, Tales Machado, agradeceu a disponibilidade de diálogo da Login-TVV e da MSC ao longo do processo e atenção nas ações que estão sendo desenvolvidas. “Como entidades, vamos sempre atuar na busca de soluções, bem como na defesa dos interesses de nossos associados”, afirmou. O diretor comercial da MSC, Laurent Vandervoo, participou do evento ao lado do diretor de linha e capacity, João Neto, e da gerente comercial, Samanta Lazarini. “O setor de rochas tem uma importância enorme no nosso business. Pontualmente, tivemos algumas questões que levaram ao estrangulamento dos embarques, mas a MSC está extremamente envolvida e trabalhando de forma árdua, juntamente com o TVV e outros atores, para tentar voltar à situação normal o mais rápido possível”, afirmou Vandervoo. Como uma das ações previstas para minimizar os impactos operacionais, o armador decidiu alterar o serviço de BTP de Santos para o Rio de Janeiro, como anunciado em primeira mão pelo diretor João Neto. “Ainda faremos a comunicação formal, mas já posso adiantar que, a partir de junho, vamos fazer esta mudança e isso vai trazer ganho de tempo nas operações, pela distância menor de Vitória até o Rio, e evitar congestionamento de cargas, pois o porto do novo destino tem menos movimento do que o de Santos”, explicou. Em sua apresentação, o diretor de terminais da Login-TVV, Ilson Hulle, destacou as ações traçadas para gerar capacidade de operação no sistema em curto, médio e longo prazo. “Neste momento, passamos por algumas circunstâncias não planejadas, mas temos ações previstas e outras já implantadas”, pontuou. Entre elas está a autorização para manobras noturnas, para navios de até 220 metros, que deve acontecer até maio. Com esta liberação, haverá uma média de ganho de 7 horas, por escala. Além disso, o processo para desestatização da Codesa deve passar pelo leilão para escolha do modelo de gestão, em novembro. “Temos acompanhado de perto todos os trâmites e acreditamos que possam surgir oportunidades como aumento da capacidade de armazenagem, novos berços de contêiner e calado total de 12,5m”, detalhou. O gerente comercial da Login-TVV, Pedro Benevides, também participou do webinar que contou com mediação do diretor executivo do Centrorochas e Sindirochas, Celmo de Freitas.

texto: The Tibet Autonomous Region in southwest China will build three new airports, a move to further improve the region’s extensive transportation system, according to the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC). The National Development and Reform Commission has approved the construction of three new airports and the expansion of Lhasa’s Gonggar Airport in Tibet, CAAC reported. The three new airports will be located in Lhunze District, Tingri District and Burang District respectively. The expansion project will involve building a second runway at Lhasa’s Gonggar Airport. Total investment in the project is expected to exceed 13.6 billion yuan (about US$2.09 billion). The project aims to better meet the demand of residents for travel, emergency rescue and socioeconomic development in the region. Transport has been a bottleneck limiting Tibet’s development, as the region is situated on the Qinghai-Tibet plateau, with complex geographical conditions for road construction. Since the end of 2012, China has been increasing its investments in infrastructure in Tibet. The region has launched a total of 130 air routes, with 61 cities connected by flights. The number of passenger trips made through these airports totaled 5.18 million in 2020. Source: portuguese.xinhuanet.com

texto: A Região Autônoma do Tibet, no sudoeste da China, construirá três novos aeroportos, um movimento para melhorar ainda mais o amplo sistema de transporte da região, de acordo com a Administração de Aviação Civil da China (CAAC). A Comissão Nacional de Desenvolvimento e Reforma aprovou a construção de três novos aeroportos e a expansão do Aeroporto de Gonggar de Lhasa no Tibet, informou a CAAC. O projeto visa atender melhor a demanda dos moradores por viagens, resgate de emergência e desenvolvimento socioeconômico da região. O transporte tem sido um gargalo que limita o desenvolvimento do Tibet, já que a região está situada no planalto Qinghai-Tibet, com condições geográficas complexas para a construção de estradas. Desde o final de 2012, a China tem aumentado seus investimentos em infraestrutura no Tibet. A região lançou um total de 130 rotas aéreas, com 61 cidades conectadas por voos. O número de viagens de passageiros feitas por esses aeroportos totalizou 5,18 milhões em 2020. Fonte: portuguese.xinhuanet.com

texto: Centrorochas (Brazilian Center for Dimension Stone Exporters), with the support of Apex-Brasil (Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency), brought together participants from all regions of Brazil, adding representatives from 13 states, during the virtual seminar “Marmomac 2021: Doubts and clarifications about the participation of Brazil”. At the opening, Centrorochas’ vice-president, Fabio Cruz, highlighted that Apex-Brasil’s work with the ornamental stone sector in recent months has been fundamental to bring about the changes the segment has been going through. The councilor of the entity and president of Sindirochas, Tales Machado, reinforced the importance of this partnership and said that, more and more, businessmen can feel the advances gaining strength. Apex-Brasil’s Service Industry coordinator, Paulo Silva, introduced the theme of the event, detailing that this is the first time that the agency has carried out this type of direct action with the sector. “This year’s edition of Marmomac will be managed by the national agency and this opportunity to listen directly to businessmen is very important so that, together, we can make an event with engagement”, he reinforced. Next, the coordinator of Events Management of Events and Special Projects, Raquel Gomes Vilharva, and the analyst of the coordination of Events Management of Events and Special Projects, Luiz Marcos da Silva Junior, detailed the procedures that companies must follow to join the fair. Alongside his colleagues, the Services Industry Coordination analyst, Anderson Dib, also participated in the webinar. Marmo+Mac 2021 The fair will take place from September 29th to October 2nd, in Verona, Italy. The event will be directly executed by Apex-Brasil with the following booth options: – 16 stands of 10 m² – 12 stands of 20 m² – 02 stands of 50 m² During the presentation, Apex members reinforced that this is an original configuration, but it may be adjusted according to availability after analysis by interested companies. Registration for the event will continue until 04/28, through the link https://bit.ly/3a9v3UW. After evaluation according to the score, Apex-Brasil will publish the result (with forecast of return in the first week of May, one week after the closing of the inscriptions). Main services offered: – Online preparatory meeting – Assembly pavilion – Individual stands (standard furniture) – Official + exclusive Apex-Brasil catalog – Collective spaces (networking and meeting) – Support team – Credentials Participant Responsibilities: – Air transport, accommodation, visa, vaccination, travel insurance and other expenses – Sending samples and their promotional materials (Apex-Brasil reinforced the need to use a dispatcher authorized by the fair. Companies that encounter difficulties can contact Centrorochas, which is available to contribute to this issue) – Meeting Apex-Brasil and fair deadlines, providing necessary files and documents At the end of the event, representatives of the national agency reinforced that they are studying the customization of stands with the technical assembly team. However, interested companies must express their interest when filling out the registration form. To review the webinar: https://youtu.be/WbZ5fRewDZE

texto: O Centrorochas (Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais), com apoio da Apex-Brasil (Agência Brasileira de Promoção de Exportações e Investimentos), reuniu participantes de todas as regiões do Brasil, somando representantes em 13 estados, durante o seminário virtual “Marmomac 2021: Dúvidas e esclarecimentos sobre a participação do Brasil”. Na abertura, o vice-presidente do Centrorochas, Fabio Cruz, destacou que a atuação da Apex-Brasil junto ao setor de rochas ornamentais, nos últimos meses, tem sido fundamental para propiciar as mudanças pela qual o segmento vem passando. O conselheiro da entidade e presidente do Sindirochas, Tales Machado, reforçou a importância desta parceria e disse que, cada vez mais, os empresários podem sentir os avanços ganhando força. O coordenador de Indústria de Serviços da Apex-Brasil, Paulo Silva, introduziu o tema do evento detalhando que esta é a primeira vez que a agência faz esse tipo de ação direta com o setor. “A edição deste ano da Marmomac terá gestão da agência nacional e esta oportunidade de ouvir diretamente os empresários é muito importante para, juntos, fazermos um evento com engajamento”, reforçou. Na sequência, a coordenadora de Eventos Gerência de Eventos e Projetos Especiais, Raquel Gomes Vilharva, e o analista da coordenação de Eventos Gerência de Eventos e Projetos Especiais, Luiz Marcos da Silva Junior, detalharam sobre os trâmites que as empresas devem seguir para fazer adesão à feira. Ao lado de seus colegas, o analista da Coordenação de Indústria de Serviços, Anderson Dib, também participou do webinar. Marmo+Mac 2021 A feira acontecerá de 29 de setembro a 02 de outubro, em Verona, na Itália. O evento terá execução direta da Apex-Brasil com as seguintes opções de estandes: – 16 estandes de 10 m² – 12 estandes de 20 m² – 02 estandes de 50 m² Durante a apresentação, os membros da Apex reforçaram que esta é uma configuração original, mas poderá sofrer ajustes conforme disponibilidade após análise das empresas interessadas. As inscrições para o evento seguem até 28/04, por meio do link https://bit.ly/3a9v3UW . Após avaliação conforme pontuação, a Apex-Brasil divulgará o resultado (com previsão de retorno na primeira semana de maio, uma semana após o encerramento das inscrições). Principais serviços oferecidos: – Reunião preparatória online – Montagem pavilhão – Estandes individuais (mobiliário padrão) – Catálogo oficial + exclusivo Apex-Brasil – Espaços coletivos (networking e reunião) – Equipe de apoio – Credenciais Responsabilidade dos participantes: – Transporte aéreo, hospedagem, visto, vacinação, seguro-viagem e demais despesas – Envio de amostras e seus materiais promocionais (A Apex-Brasil reforçou sobre a necessidade de usar o despachante autorizado pela feira. As empresas que encontrarem dificuldades, podem procurar o Centrorochas, que está à disposição para contribuir nesta questão) – Cumprimento dos prazos da Apex-Brasil e feira, fornecer arquivos e documentos necessários Ao final do evento, os representantes da agência nacional reforçaram que estão estudando sobre a personalização de estandes junto à equipe técnica de montagem. No entanto, as empresas interessadas, devem manifestar interesse durante preenchimento do formulário de inscrição Para rever o webinar: https://youtu.be/WbZ5fRewDZE

texto: The use of market intelligence data to boost ornamental stone exports was the subject of the webinar held on Wednesday, April 7, by Centrorochas (Brazilian Center for Ornamental Stones Exporters). With around 50 participants, the event brought together representatives of exporting companies that want to start participating in the international market. At the opening, the executive director of Centrorochas, Celmo de Freitas, reinforced the importance of the platform. “BI Centrorochas is a very rich tool that should be exploited to the fullest by entrepreneurs and their commercial teams,” he said. BI Centrorochas, a commercial intelligence program that assists in the analysis of segment data, was presented by consultant Severo Martinez, who detailed the new functionalities of the tool capable of assisting users in in-depth analyzes of commercial behavior and boosting sales in the foreign market. After the presentation of the news and in an interactive way, Centrorochas project manager, Rogério Ribeiro, and market intelligence coordinator, Luiz Gustavo Drumond, simulated approaches both in the target country and in a situation of searching for a potential market for business expansion . The examples resulted in a rich sharing of information for exporters who also had the opportunity to participate and clarify their doubts. Organized by Centrorochas, the event was conducted by the entity’s superintendent, Alessandra Bertolani. To review the webinar, click here!

texto: Finding ways to differentiate yourself using business intelligence data is one way to maximize sales in target markets. Following one of its main pillars, which is the sharing of knowledge, Centrorochas will hold, on April 7th (Wednesday), the free virtual seminar “How to use commercial intelligence data to boost your sales in the international market”. With more than 20 years of experience in market intelligence and new business development, consultant Severo Martinez will present all the new functionalities of BI Centrorochas, a platform that offers entrepreneurs in the ornamental stone sector (exporters or even those who intend to enter in the international market) a system for querying statistical data regarding imports and exports. Launched in 2019, BI Centrorochas is a commercial intelligence program that has several modules. In it, entrepreneurs have (at the reach of a click) information that directly impacts the decision-making of companies. It shows the data very clearly, which facilitates interpretation and, consequently, decisions that are no longer just intuitive. The platform is available for computers and mobile devices (Android or IOS system). Version 3.0 Launched this March, the new platform update offers users new charts, innovative applications and expansion of countries in its database. A complementary menu was inserted in the “World” module, providing three functionalities (general graphs, partner countries and evolution) that will help in the analysis of information on target countries, whose database increased from 3 to 30 countries (UNC base). This new menu also gained two new buttons: “Potential Markets” (where details of the main countries to which Brazil sent dimension stones between 2014 and 2020 are gathered) and “Relatório Extractificado Apex-Brasil” (which presents a summary of the Extracted Report Assessment of Potential Markets for Ornamental Stones – Apex-Brasil”, with information on the 40 countries that purchased the most from the national segment in 2019). Those interested in participating in this webinar must register, which is free. Click here! BI Centrorochas Webinar How to use commercial intelligence data to boost your sales in the international market Date: 07/04 (Wednesday) Time: 3 pm Registration: http://bit.ly/2ORtCmV

texto: Gathered in a virtual Extraordinary General Assembly (AGE) this Friday, March 26, Centrorochas associates deliberated on partial adjustments to the association’s bylaws and were updated on the status of the sectoral project It’s Natural – Brazilian Natural Stone developed by the entity in partnership with Apex-Brasil. All businessmen present were very optimistic about the expected formalization of the agreement and the actions involved, which reflects the expectations of the sector. At the opening of the meeting, the president of Centrorochas, Frederico Robison, reinforced the importance of modernizing the statute that aims to speed up processes, adapt the entity to the new reality of the national stone sector and clarify gaps that were not addressed by the statute. Main amendments to the bylaws – Associates In addition to the two current forms of association: permanent associate and collaborator associate, the entity now has two more categories for association: institutional associate (which will cover employers’ unions and partner entities) and special associate (category created to receive companies that have not yet export, but who are interested in entering the international market. If it does not carry out an export activity within a period of two years, it automatically migrates to the associate-collaborator modality). – Composition of the Deliberative and Fiscal Council Formation of an electoral slate with a minimum of 7 members for the Board, and a maximum of 14, in addition to a minimum of 3 alternates and a maximum of 10. , the Council may ratify its permanence until the end of the mandate. – Consulting board Creation of an Advisory Board made up of all former presidents of Centrorochas and presidents of partner employer unions (institutional associate). – New address Centrorochas is operating in a new room. The association’s headquarters kept the address, but moved to a larger room. The exchange became necessary with the growth of the technical team due to the new projects on which the entity has been working. New Centrorochas address Av. Nossa Senhora da Penha, 1495, Ed. Corporate Center – Room 1204, Tower A – Santa Lúcia – Vitória – ES – 29.056-905

Na abertura do encontro, o presidente do Centrorochas, Frederico Robison, reforçou a importância da modernização do estatuto que visa dar mais celeridade aos processos, adequar a entidade à nova realidade do setor de rochas nacional e esclarecer lacunas que não eram tratadas pelo estatuto. Principais alterações do estatuto – Associados Além das duas modalidades atuais para associação: associado efetivo e associado colaborador, a entidade passa a contar com mais duas categorias para associação: associado institucional (que abrangerá sindicatos patronais e entidades parceiras) e associado especial (categoria criada para receber as empresas que ainda não exportam, mas que têm interesse em entrar no mercado internacional. Caso ela não realize atividade de exportação em um prazo de dois anos, ela migra automaticamente para a modalidade associado colaborador). – Composição do Conselho Deliberativo e Fiscal Formação de chapa eleitoral com o mínimo de 7 membros para o Conselho, e máximo de 14, além de no mínimo 3 suplentes e máximo de 10. Caso algum dos Conselheiros eleitos perca o vínculo com a empresa associada pela qual foi indicado a concorrer ao cargo, o Conselho poderá ratificar sua permanência até conclusão do mandato. – Conselho Consultivo Criação de Conselho Consultivo formado por todos os ex-presidentes do Centrorochas e presidentes dos sindicatos patronais parceiros (associado institucional). – Novo endereço O Centrorochas está funcionando em nova sala. A sede da associação manteve o endereço, mas migrou para uma sala mais ampla. A troca se fez necessária com o crescimento da equipe técnica em razão dos novos projetos em que a entidade tem trabalhado. Novo endereço Centrorochas Av. Nossa Senhora da Penha, 1.495, Ed. Corporate Center – Sala 1204, Torre A – Santa Lúcia – Vitória – ES – 29.056-905

texto: The search for greater competitiveness and participation of the Brazilian stone sector in the international market has been the focal point of exporting companies that, led by Centrorochas, follow a new path in search of increased sales abroad and the conquest of new markets. In order for these results to be achieved, the Brazilian Center for Ornamental Stones Exporters is investing in the qualification of its talents. This Thursday, March 11, Rogério Ribeiro, a professional who arrives at the institution to manage the movement, a milestone of the new moment in the stone sector, left for South Africa, where he will stay for two months in an intensive course in order to improve your fluency in English. “This qualification will guarantee more quality of service to the entire sector. The work we are designing is going to revolutionize both the businessmen’s relationship with Centrorochas and the businessmen’s relationship with the outside world. We are going to maximize exports, bringing benefits to the entire segment”, he highlighted. An agronomist graduated from the Federal University of Espírito Santo (UFES), with a post-graduate degree in Public Law with an emphasis on Public Management, Rogério has been working in the ornamental stone sector since 2002 and will lead this new project alongside the vice president of Centrorochas, Fabio Cross. Rogério Ribeiro em frente à obra “Pedra Azul, o Frade e a Freira”, do designer e artista plástico Ronaldo Barbosa, que especificou o granito Preto São Gabriel e o mármore Branco Cachoeiro, de jazidas da Marbrasa, na elaboração da peça. O painel está instalado no saguão principal do Aeroporto de Vitória.

texto: Um novo passo para composição da representatividade do setor de rochas nacional foi dado na última quinta-feira, 11 de fevereiro, quando o Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais ( Centrorochas ) protocolou proposta de novo projeto setorial junto à Agência Brasileira de Promoção de Exportações e Investimentos ( APEX-Brasil ). Como entidade, nosso objetivo com o plano registrado é fortalecer e aumentar a presença das rochas brasileiras no mercado internacional. A insatisfação do empresariado com a estagnação no volume de exportações, que há 12 anos praticamente não registra alteração em seus números, nos levou a desenvolver uma proposta inovadora e, de forma inédita, desenvolvida com a ampla participação das empresas do segmento. O setor de rochas brasileiro é detentor do maior convênio com a agência nacional e iniciou, no final de 2019, um trabalho para revisão do processo de apoio ao segmento e elegeu o Centrorochas como representante nacional. Desde o ano passado, a entidade fortaleceu o processo de mobilização empresarial para construção desse novo projeto para o setor, que contou com participação ativa dos empresários e apoiadores aderente aos anseios do segmento por uma nova representatividade nacional, dentre estes, lideranças do setor no Rio de Janeiro e os sindicatos patronais dos maiores estados exportadores do Brasil: Sindirochas-ES (Sindicato das Indústrias de Rochas Ornamentais, Cal e Calcários do Estado do Espírito Santo), Sinrochas-MG (Sindicato Intermunicipal das Indústrias de Beneficiamento de Mármores, Granitos e Rochas Ornamentais no Estado de Minas Gerais) e Simagran-CE (Sindicato das Indústrias de Mármores e Granitos do Estado do Ceará). Na última quinta-feira, 11, divulgamos um comunicado informando sobre o protocolo do ‘It’s Natural: Brazilian Natural Stone” junto à Apex-Brasil. O texto reforça que o trabalho em conjunto foi e continuará sendo nosso grande diferencial, aliado à transparência durante toda a execução do projeto. A partir de agora, a agência nacional fará uma criteriosa análise na proposta para emitir seu parecer. E nós continuaremos trabalhando unidos, com clareza e lisura, como foi feito durante toda execução da proposta. Juntos somos mais fortes e espalharemos todo nosso orgulho e confiança na potencialidade do setor de rochas tanto no Brasil como em todos os países do globo. Fabio Cruz, vice-presidente do Centro Brasileiro dos Exportadores de Rochas Ornamentais (Centrorochas)
